articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition of Structures in Earth and Rock Dam Images Based on Mask-RCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Intelligent water conservancy to the traditional method of intelligent recognition of earth and rock dam structure usually has low accuracy and low efficiency. This paper proposes a method for recognizing the structure of earth-rock dams in images based on Mask-RCNN, which acquires the homemade dataset of earth and rock dam images by UAV, obtains the weight file, and realizes the semantic segmentation of the structure of earth and rock dam images through labeling training. Mask-RCNN replaces ROIpooling with ROIAlign to solve the problem that the feature maps can not be accurately aligned with the original pixels., which makes the accuracy of the mask significantly improved from 10% to 50%. The results show that this method can effectively segment and recognize the spillway culverts on the dam body and dam top, and the classification accuracy reaches 97%, which provides a reliable intelligent management basis for the basic geographic data of intelligent water conservancy projects.

articleTitle: Image Diversity Restoration Algorithm Based on Unsupervised Sample Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The existing image restoration algorithms are unable to solve the problem of modeling conditional probability distributions with known jointly distributed sample data, and an unsupervised sample-guided image diversification restoration algorithm (DIIUSG) is proposed to address this problem. The algorithm realizes image restoration by superimposing the hidden coding of the image to be restored and the hidden coding of the sample image in the hidden space, and then feeding them into the decoder. As the sample images are transformed continuously, the diversified restoration of images can be realized. The DIIUSG network architecture proposed in this paper consists of encoder, decoder and discriminator network structures and multiple loss functions. The network can automatically learn the image contents from the samples, and for the same image to be restored, different bootstrap samples will generate different results, thus realizing diversified image restoration. The proposed algorithm is validated on four standard datasets, including CelebA-HQ, and compared qualitatively and quantitatively with existing deep neural network-based image restoration algorithms, and the experimental results show that the proposed method performs well in several metrics. The experimental results also show that the proposed method solves the modeling problem of solving conditional probability distributions with known joint distribution samples.

articleTitle: A New Method of Core and Grounding Short Circuit Detection of Secondary DC Cable in Substation
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The problems of secondary DC cable in substation mainly include grounding fault and core anomaly. Traditional grounding failure and core detection methods require power outage operation, which not only increases the workload, but also may cause interference to the operation of the power grid. Therefore, the development of a short circuit detection method for core and grounding has important application value. To address this problem, a new approach is proposed. This method first obtains the equivalent capacitance parameters of the cable to be tested, then constructs the oscillation detection loop, and takes the equivalent capacitance as part of the oscillation detection loop. Next, by monitoring the change of the oscillation frequency, judge the core information or ground fault information. With the help of cable equivalent capacitance parameters, this method can realize the core detection and grounding fault detection of DC cable. When the DC cable is grounded or abnormal, the equivalent capacitor will change significantly. By monitoring the equivalent cable capacitance value parameters and the oscillation frequency, the grounding state or the core condition of the DC cable can be reflected. Compared with the traditional methods, this new method has the advantages of being safe, reliable, simple and efficient. It does not require a power outage operation, but can detect and check the cable online, reducing the work burden and maintaining the normal operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: SleepGNet: Automatic Sleep Staging Model Based on Graph Convolu-tional Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Sleep has an indispensable role in human health. It serves as an essential function that help maintain healthy both mentally and physically. Many people nowadays do not conform to healthy sleep patterns. Furthermore, insufficient access to sleep education and treatment aids leads to people engaging in harmful sleep behaviors and requiring treatment for sleep disorders, which has caused a sleep crisis and is a public issue. Sleep stage classification is a great tool for helping solve these disorders and improve the sleep quality of humans. Yet, classifying all sleep stages accurately and automatically based on extracting features from multiple EEG epochs is a challenging task. In this work, a novel sleep staging model is proposed, which is named SleepGNet. The time frequency images derived from EEG epochs as input are transformed into sequential images through the parallel filter-bank layers. In order to achieve faster convergence during training procedure and more accurate classification results with fewer training times, Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) is used to dig the connections between every epochs more effectively. Experimental results on Sleep-EDF database indicate that SleepGNet outperforms the state-of-the-art sleep staging methods and the overall accuracy is about 86.6%.

articleTitle: Music Note Feature Recognition based on Dynamic Time Warping Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Traditional methods for classifying and recognizing musical note features suffer from low accuracy. In response, we propose a music note feature recognition method leveraging the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm. The approach begins with an in-depth analysis of musical notes, utilizing the similarity matrix of note similarity under the standard distance of notes as the DTW distance matrix. From this matrix, we derive a criterion for selecting note features, which serves as the objective function for optimizing the subset of music note features. By operating with multiple populations, we obtain the expected value of higher musical note classification accuracy from various populations, serving as the quality evaluation for multi-population classification. Subsequently, a global objective evaluation is conducted on each musical note based on the evaluation values, facilitating music note classification and recognition. Experimental results validate the efficacy of the proposed method, demonstrating its ease of adoption in computer-assisted systems. Moreover, it achieves higher accuracy in music note feature classification and recognition, while reducing the overall recognition time compared to existing musical note feature extraction methods.

articleTitle: Method of Ethnic Minority Costume Image Retrieval Based on Deep Hashing
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To solve the problems of low accuracy, high cost, and poor efficiency in image retrieval of ethnic minority costumes, a deep hash image retrieval method combining image generation and image enhancement technologies is proposed. This method utilizes image generation technology to effectively improve the quality of the dataset. It employs corresponding image enhancement techniques for images within different brightness mean ranges to improve the image feature contrast. The deep hash algorithm is used to calculate the hash values of each image feature. By comparing the Hamming distance, the retrieval of ethnic minority costumes is achieved. Experimental results show that, compared to ordinary hash retrieval methods, this method not only improves the success rate of the top 5 image retrievals but also enhances the accuracy and recall rate of image retrieval. It can effectively realize the retrieval and identification of costumes of the Bai, Manchu, Miao, and Uighur ethnic groups, providing an important theoretical basis for the study of ethnic minority cultures, understanding of folk customs, and promotion of ethnic unity.

articleTitle: Fine Motion Capture Algorithm Based on Virtual Reality and Its Application in Sports Training Research
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Recently, researchers have increasingly focused on the utilization of deep learning-based Virtual Reality (VR) technology and motion capture techniques in sports training. This study addresses challenges related to noise and data incompleteness in motion capture within VR sports training. It introduces the DLPMA algorithm for motion data reconstruction. To overcome limitations of traditional deep learning in recognizing complex motion features accurately, an enhanced Graph Convolutional Neural Network (GCN) is proposed for action recognition. The integration of these approaches results in a comprehensive VR motion capture and recognition model. Experimental results shows that the model’s accuracies on the NTU-RGB D and UMONS-TAICHI datasets, reaching 0.914 and 0.983, with an average recognition error rate of 0.03. Thus, the model effectively enhances motion capture precision and realism, improves action recognition, and consequently boosts the effectiveness of sports training.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Feature Extraction of Human Body Motion Video Images Based on Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This study addresses the deficiencies in the analysis of local parameters of target features in human motion video images during the rapid extraction of local features. This deficiency leads to inaccurate description of low-level feature maps when constructing hierarchical structures of video images, thereby increasing extraction time and resulting in lower recall and precision rates. To address this issue, a method for rapidly extracting local features of target objects in human motion video images is proposed. By utilizing the information entropy between adjacent frames of human motion video images and combining it with density functions to determine initial clustering centers, the number of clusters is calculated to facilitate the analysis of local parameters of target features in human motion video images. The study constructs a hierarchical structure of human motion video images by selecting feature maps from the convolutional output layer. The method introduces information entropy to describe low-level feature maps of human motion video images and combines it with regional averaging to describe high-level feature maps, ultimately completing the extraction of local features in human motion video images. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves rapid extraction of local features in human motion video images, with shorter feature extraction times and higher recall and precision rates.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Node Importance in Complex Networks Based on K-Shell Position and Node Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The K-Shell decomposition method can quickly identify the core nodes in complex networks, but cannot accurately distinguish within the same shell layer. Therefore, when using the K -shell decomposition method, it is necessary to pay attention to its limitations and comprehensively consider other factors to comprehensively evaluate the importance of nodes. This article proposes a network node importance evaluation method based on node ks value and node local information entropy. This method calculates the local entropy of nodes based on the information of nodes and their second-order neighbors. During the calculation process, the influence of the network structure of nodes on entropy value is considered, and a compensation mechanism is adopted. Finally, Simulation experiments were conducted on four networks, and the results showed that the proposed method can more accurately and effectively evaluate the importance of distinguishing nodes.

Index Terms: Importance Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: HRNet: Local-Spatial Feature Fusion Network for Texture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Texture recognition is a challenging and complex task within the realm of computer vision, because texture images contain local texture detail information and spatial distribution of feature. Some existing Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) approaches emphasize local feature distribution and encoding, relying solely on pooling operations to characterize global spatial feature. However, these approaches overlook the global spatial feature that cannot be fully captured by pooling operations. To address this problem, a Local-Spatial Feature Fusion Network named HRNet is proposed, HRNet consists of three prominent modules: histogram layer module, residual pooling module and feature fusion module. Histogram layer module constructs histograms to depict the feature distribution of local regions. Residual pooling module exploits residual connections and feature learning to extract spatial features. Finally, feature fusion module integrates the output features of the two modules to form a comprehensive texture representation. HRNet achieves accuracies of $75.1 \%, 87.2 \%$, and $85.4 \%$ on three challenging and complex texture recognition datasets DTD, FMD, and MINC-2500, respectively. The proposed HRNet not only demonstrates outstanding performance in capturing local and global texture features, but also achieves advanced performance on challenging datasets.

articleTitle: A 5G Positioning Method Based on Multi-fingerprint Features and Improved WKNN
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low positioning accuracy caused by a single feature of 5G signals representing location information in complex environments, this paper proposes a 5G positioning method based on multi-fingerprint features and an improved WKNN algorithm. Multiple 5G signal features are used to define location fingerprints in this algorithm in order to capture location information more comprehensively. Considering the contributions of different fingerprint features for location information, the ReliefF algorithm is used to calculate the weight of each fingerprint feature which is used to improve the distance calculation method in the WKNN algorithm. Experimental results show that compared with 5G positioning methods that rely on a single fingerprint feature, the 5G positioning method based on multi-fingerprint features and improved WKNN proposed in this article has higher positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: BIVD: Improved Side Adapter Network based on BiFormer
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Currently, most open vocabulary models rely on CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) to classify masked regions, but CLIP models still have many drawbacks. The traditional transformer model is context aware through self attention, but this local context based mechanism is limited by the sequence length of information, it can also impact model effect. Inspired by the article BiFormer, This article replaces the traditional transformer model in the Side Adapter Network (SAN) model with a variant module BIVD block based on BiFormer blocks. This model follows the latest transformer model and extracts features using a four layer feature pyramid structure, For the reduced spatial resolution caused by patch merging, add a Visual-Decoder to reshape the visual vector sequence into a spatial feature map, and restore it to the original resolution through convolution and upsampling. This can enhance the extracted feature information through a feature pyramid without affecting the fusion with CLIP layer features. But the cost is increasing the cost of the model. This article was tested on 5 commonly used datasets and showed a stable improvement in accuracy.

articleTitle: Recognition of Painful Expressions in Elderly People Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To enhance the medical and daily care needs of the elderly, this study focuses on the field of home care robots and proposes a deep learning based pain expression recognition algorithm for the elderly. Firstly, a set of elderly facial expression images was constructed, covering the facial expressions of elderly people under different degrees of pain. Furthermore, image preprocessing techniques such as Gaussian filtering are used to improve the quality of these images and make them more suitable for training machine learning models. Secondly, using the idea of transfer learning, the initially trained VGG16 model is used to recognize facial pain expressions in elderly people, and detailed analysis and extraction of facial features are carried out. During the model training process, we adopted a grid search method to adjust the model parameters. By adjusting different parameter combinations, we found the optimal model configuration, which helps to improve the performance of the model and make it more accurate in recognizing pain expressions. The results show that our pain expression recognition algorithm has high accuracy, with a recognition rate of $90.5\%$. This means that the algorithm has shown good application prospects in monitoring the pain status of elderly people.

articleTitle: Improving Remote Sensing Image Classification through Stochastic Bilevel Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the study of interpreting remote sensing images, the issue of noise in training samples is a significant concern. Many research works have demonstrated the outstanding performance of convolutional neural network(CNN) in the interpretation of remote sensing scenes. However, due to accuracy problems in sample labeling, CNN often struggle to correctly identify “true features.” This paper explores a new paradigm of sample contributionweighted learning based on dual-layer stochastic optimization. The objective is to ensure that during model training, samples are correctly identified, with the neural network paying greater attention to “correct samples” while gradually neglecting “poorquality samples” over training iterations. The learning strategy comprises two training loops: an outer loop for updating neural network-related weights and an inner loop for calculating the contribution of training data to the outer loop weight updates. Through iterative processes, the influence of low-contributing samples on the loss function is gradually reduced. The method provides a new perspective on handling the issue of noisy annotations in remote sensing images.

articleTitle: An LTE Fingerprint Localization Method based on Combined KNN and LSTM Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the comprehensive coverage of the LTE network, LTE fingerprint localization has become one of the research hotspots of indoor localization. In the offline phase, this paper uses the performance metrics of LTE Cell Reference Signal (CRS) as location fingerprint features to build a fingerprint database. In the online stage, the fingerprint matching algorithm is a key factor affecting the localization accuracy, to make full use of the structural information and temporal correlation of sequential fingerprint features, this paper proposes a LTE fingerprint localization method based on the combination of KNN and LSTM prediction. The method adopts the K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm (KNN) and Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) to predict the moving target location simultaneously and fuses the prediction results with the residual inverse method. The experimental results show that the localization accuracy of the proposed algorithm in this paper is improved by 9.02% and 33.71% over the KNN and LSTM alone for LTE fingerprint localization.

articleTitle: Discrimination of Emotional Valence Based on Physiological Signals in the Hand and Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As a basic function of the human brain, emotions are an important factor influencing people’s behavior and decision-making. Physiological signals come from the autonomic nervous system activity in the human body, and its change law is closely related to the physiological and emotional activity of the human body, so it can be used as a basis for accurate judgment of emotional state. At present, the emotion analysis method based on machine intelligence has become a research hotspot. In this paper, the skin electrical signals, pulse wave signals and blood oxygen saturation signals in the hand are analyzed, and a machine learning model is constructed to distinguish positive and negative emotions. 50 college students received emotional induction based on video clips of different emotional colors, and truthfully reported their emotional status. The SC signal, pulse wave and blood oxygen saturation signal are collected synchronously through the finger sleeve. By extracting the time domain and frequency domain feasures of the SC signal and its difference, the time domain and morphological features of the pulse wave signal, the statistical values and change rate of the blood oxygen saturation signal, the support vector machine is selected as the classifier. Finally, the accuracy of distinguishing positive and negative is 80.5%.The F1 score is 0.784. The results show that the emotional valence discrimination model based on SC signals and pulse oxygen saturation signals can effectively identify emotions.

articleTitle: A Pupil Diameter Measurement System Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: At present, the measurement of pupil diameter is often carried out with specialized medical equipment, combining infrared optical and acoustic methods. However, for the general public, these instruments are often expensive and not worth buying. In order to solve this problem, taking into account that with the gradual popularization of electronic devices, the camera has become a necessary item in the hands of each of us, combined with the current rapid development of image processing technology, we set up an image processing based on the measurement of the pupil diameter system, we through the camera to take pictures of the eye, the use of grayscale conversion, threshold segmentation and other image processing methods, to extract the pupil of the eye region, combined with our size measurement algorithms, the pupil diameter measurement system, and then the pupil diameter measurement algorithm. We extract the pupil area of our human eye by using image processing methods such as gray-to-gray conversion and threshold segmentation. At the same time, because the pupil area obtained from the camera is dynamically changing, we get the dynamically changing value of the pupil diameter of the human eye. It has been exhibited that the pupil of the human eye is not a perfect circle, but is actually closer to an irregular ellipse, so we use the least squares method to fit the pupil contour of the human eye to an ellipse before measurement. In order to improve the accuracy of the final measurement, we calculated the actual length of each pixel in the horizontal and vertical coordinates to complete our final measurement of the pupil diameter.

articleTitle: Task Offloading Based on Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning for UAV-assisted Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The field of Edge Computing (EC) has emerged as a significant advancement that allows Internet of Things (IoT) devices to efficiently manage complex tasks while prolonging their operational lifespan. The focus of this study is on the utilization of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to augment edge computing systems with the goal of minimizing energy usage during computational tasks. We propose a novel approach that employs multi-agent reinforcement learning to facilitate task offloading in a UAV-supported edge computing setup. This method swiftly devises offloading strategies without the protracted computations typically associated with conventional optimization algorithms. Through experimental trials, we have found that our proposed solution not only reduces the energy required for computing tasks but also enhances the overall efficiency of task processing and demonstrates robust performance stability.

articleTitle: High Precision Pose Estimation Method for Table Tennis Athlete Based on Optimized Non-Negative Matrix Factorization
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Achieving high-performance pose estimation is crucial for ensuring equality in high-standard sports games and athlete training systems. This paper proposes a computer-assisted intelligent image feature extraction method for athlete pose estimation, with a specific focus on the Non-Negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) approach. The research addresses challenges posed by noisy and diverse pose data in real-world scenarios. By employing NMF, pose estimation accuracy, covering object recognition and scene understanding is largely improved. Finally, the proposed techniques for intelligent athlete pose feature extraction undergo a comprehensive evaluation, considering both effectiveness and versatility by comprehensive experiment verifications. The experiment results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method and show the superior pose estimation accuracy of the proposed method over the existing methods. The proposed method provides an important assistance to the high standard table tennis sports games and its corresponding training system.

articleTitle: 3D Clothing Wrinkle Modeling Method Based on Gaussian Curvature and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer vision and artificial intelligence technology, deep learning has become a key technology in the field of 3D clothing design, especially showing great potential in accurately simulating and optimizing garment folding effects. Traditional clothing design methods are difficult to overcome the complexity and time consumption of wrinkle modeling. This article analyzes the application of clothing wrinkles in 3D design from the perspective of deep learning technology. It uses convolutional neural network to standardize and classify the effect images of wrinkles, in order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of designers in processing wrinkle effect images. Gaussian curvature is used to calculate the degree of wrinkle bending. Finally, this article conducts research on clothing wrinkles of different objects, and the research results show that convolutional neural networks are applied to the design research of clothing wrinkles. It can not only improve design accuracy, but also enhance design efficiency, promoting the development of the clothing industry to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on Building Crack Detection Method Based on Improved Canny Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the limitations of traditional Canny operator in removing false edges and protecting edge details in the edge detection process of building crack images, this paper proposes an improved Canny operator and applies it to the edge extraction of building cracks. A hybrid filter and a median filter are cascaded to preprocess the building crack image. At the same time, the subdivision division method is used in the preprocessing stage to segment the image and remove the isolated points, so as to obtain a clearer image. The nonlinear median filter is used to replace the Gaussian filter in the original algorithm. Combined with the maximum interclass variance method and the gradient histogram algorithm, a new high and low threshold is calculated. This method not only effectively preserves the edge details, but also significantly reduces the generation of false edges. Compared with the traditional method, the method proposed in this paper has obvious advantages in extracting the edge of building crack image. The experimental results show that this method can extract clearer and more complete image edges, and the performance of peak signal-to-noise ratio and false edge suppression is also improved to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent ATC Equipment for Urban Railways
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: During the manufacturing and debugging process of urban rail vehicles, there are many signals in the ATC section, which is time-consuming, laborious, and prone to errors. Although a debugging fixture consisting of knob switches and indicator lights has also been made for easy debugging, it still appears a bit cumbersome and inconvenient in today’s rapidly developing digital debugging. This article is based on MQTT communication technology and develops an intelligent ATC debugging device consisting of an upper computer and a lower computer. It can receive debugging tasks issued by the digital debugging platform, automatically output signals directly, and perform level detection on the corresponding pins. In the process of debugging the actual application prototype, the accuracy of the debugging process has been greatly improved, the labor intensity of workers has been reduced, and a solid foundation has been laid for the promotion of digital debugging.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization Strategy of Train ATO Based on Improved Grey Wolf Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of safety, energy conservation, punctuality, comfort and other indicators in the operation process of train ATO, a multi-objective optimization strategy based on improved Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) algorithm was proposed. Firstly, based on the train operation control strategy and dynamic equations, an evaluation function for performance indicators such as energy consumption, punctuality, comfort, and parking error of train ATO was constructed, and a multi-objective optimization mathematical model for the train was established; Then, based on the principles and drawbacks of the GWO algorithm, the initialization and position update methods were improved, enhancing the optimization ability of the GWO algorithm. The improved GWO algorithm was validated through testing functions to effectively compensate for the shortcomings of the GWO algorithm; Finally, the improved GWO algorithm was applied to multi-objective optimization of train ATO, and simulation experiments showed that the energy consumption, actual running time, comfort value, and parking error of train operation were significantly improved, verifying the effectiveness of this strategy.

articleTitle: Cross-modal Retrieval with Attention Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Due to the efficiency of computation and storage, the dual-encoder model has been usually utilized for retrieval tasks involving a large volume of multimodal data. The dualencoder model trains visual tokens and text tokens separately, and ignores the interaction between modalities. Due to the lack of interaction, the cross-model retrieval performance of dualencoder modal is not good. On the contrary, the fusion-encoder model inputs text tokens and visual tokens together into a multimodal encoder, which provides sufficient interaction between modalities. But the search process of fusion-encoder model is both inefficient and impractical. To take advantage the strengths of the both models and avoid their disadvantages, this article proposes CAKD (a cross-modal retrieval method with attention knowledge distillation). This method uses a fusion-encoder model as the teacher model and a dual-encoder model as the student model. CAKD not only ensure the synchronization of predictions from the teacher and the student, but also enable the student to learn interaction information from the teacher by distilling attention knowledge. This method was validated on the MIRFLICKR-25K and MS-COCO. Experiment results show that cross modal retrieval performance of CAKD has decreased by approximately $4 \%$ compared with the teacher model, but the retrieval time of CAKD is ${1 2 0 0}$ times faster than that of the teacher model and the cross modal retrieval performance is superior to current mainstream dual-encoder model.

articleTitle: Off-grid Control Technology for Distributed Mobile Energy Storage System Based on Multi-machine Parallel Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In off-grid mode, the voltage and current stability of microgrids are poor, which can lead to poor performance of distributed mobile energy storage system (DMESS) off-grid control. To address this issue, a method based on multi-machine parallel operation for off-grid control of DMESS is proposed. A model of multi-machine parallel operation for DMESS is designed, and the power allocation ratio of parallel machines is determined reasonably. Through the dual-loop control technology of outer loop capacitor voltage and inner loop capacitor current, the dynamic performance and load disturbance resistance of the energy storage system are improved, realizing stable control of voltage and current during microgrid off-grid operation. Experimental results demonstrate that when a 45 kW, 10 kVar load is injected into the microgrid, the designed technology can restore voltage and maintain voltage stability at 0.7 s after the load injection. When the second energy storage system is injected, stable current can be maintained, achieving current equalization. This indicates that the proposed method can effectively control the stability of microgrid voltage and current under off-grid operation and achieve current equalization, demonstrating excellent control performance.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimal Dispatch of Power System Economic Environment based on Improved MOPSO
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The particle swarm optimization (PSO) technique embodies an evolutionary approach that hinges on the enhancement of each individual, the cooperative dynamics of the group, and the underlying competitive processes. It has the characteristics of simple theory, easy coding implementation and fast convergence speed. Targeting both ecological and financial improvements within the energy grid, the dual mandate of reducing power production expenses and curtailing the release of harmful gases from the electricity station is achieved. A proposed solution for this multi-objective issue involves a refined particle swarm optimization technique, which incorporates a strategy of Pareto dominance and utilizes a ranking system based on congestion distance. An external archive collection with dynamically adjustable capacity is used to store the current Pareto optimal solution. The Pareto dominance policy is used to determine the individual optimal positions, which in turn determines the global optimal position based on the particle crowding distance. The algorithm’s search proficiency is enhanced by introducing a mechanism for slight probabilistic variation, in conjunction with the establishment of adaptive inertia weights. The sample outcomes confirm the algorithm’s efficacy.

articleTitle: Lightweight Monocular 3D Object Detection Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the field of autonomous driving, 3D target detection is an important technology. In view of the shortcomings of existing monocular 3D detection algorithms in terms of accuracy and real-time performance, we propose a lightweight 3D target detection algorithm based on the attention mechanism. In order to ensure the real-time performance of the model, we use depthwise separable convolutions in the backbone network. The feature maps of each scale are then connected to an EMA module, which can fuse spatial attention and cross-dimensional Coordinate attention is used to enhance the feature extraction capability of the network, and BiFPN is subsequently used for multi-scale feature fusion. Finally, experiments were conducted on the KITTI dataset, and the results showed that our algorithm was superior to other methods in both accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: A Groove Wedge Tightness Detection Method Based on the Mixed Characteristics of MFCC and GFCC
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Traditional generator maintenance requires the rotor to be overhauled, which is time-consuming, costly, and inefficient. In this paper, a sound signal classification algorithm for wedge tightness based on the mixed characteristics of Mel frequency cepstrum coefficient and gamma pass frequency cepstrum coefficient is proposed, which can have a high accuracy in the detection of wedge tightness of generators without pumping rotors, and thus greatly improve the maintenance efficiency of generators. Firstly, the exciter is used to knock on the wedge, and the sound sensor is used to collect the sound samples generated by the vibration of the wedge. Then, the db6 wavelet threshold function was used to denoise the sound signal of the tightness of the wedge. Then, the mixed features of MFCC and GFCC were extracted. Then, the dimensionality of the mixed feature signal is reduced to reduce the amount of computation. Finally, the Inception v4 model was used for sound classification. 3000 groups of sound signal samples of wedge tightness were collected, and the above method was used to test the tightness of the wedge, and the experimental results showed that the accuracy of the above method for judging the tightness of the wedge was $98.75 \%$.

Author Keywords: rotor fault detection is not pumped

articleTitle: Research on Athlete Image Detection and Shadow Removal Algorithms in Tennis Matches
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To validate a method proposed in this paper that combines athlete detection with an improved Gaussian mixture model to remove shadows of athletes in tennis matches, the following steps were undertaken. Initially, the circular detection method was applied to detect athletes in the match images. Subsequently, the area of background modeling was reduced based on the identified athlete positions. Addressing the issue of slow movement during tennis serve and volley, which leads to easy “missed detection,” an improved Gaussian mixture model for shadow detection using the eight-neighborhood method was proposed. Finally, the image was converted to the HSV color model, and the difference in feature values of shadow information in this color model was utilized to achieve shadow elimination. Comparative analyses were conducted to evaluate the effects of this method, Gaussian mixture modeling, and background difference modeling on shadow elimination. Additionally, shadow removal experiments were performed under different lighting conditions. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in removing shadows of athletes in tennis matches.

articleTitle: A VMD and LSTM based Method for Predicting Dissolved Gas in Transformer Oil
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The content and proportion of dissolved gas in the oil are closely related to the running state of the transformer. In order to effectively monitor the running state of the transformer and find potential problems in time, this paper proposes a state prediction model combining variational mode decomposition and long short-term memory network. The specific steps are as follows: First, the density-based clustering algorithm DBSCAN and the $3 \sigma$ criterion are used to clean the data to remove “dirty data” to ensure data quality. Secondly, it used the Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) algorithm to decompose the gas time series data into multiple Intrinsic Mode Functions (IMFs) step by step, so as to reduce the influence of noise. Finally, the time domain features and frequency domain features of gas are extracted from the original time series data and IMF components, which are used to predict the concentration of dissolved gas in oil. Experimental results show that the MAPE of the proposed network reaches $1.95 \%$ when predicting the dissolved gas content in the transformer oil after 7 days, and $3.57 \%$ when predicting the dissolved gas content in the oil after 15 days.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Unified Power Data Measurement and Acquisition System Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This article introduces the design and implementation of a unified data measurement and acquisition system based on deep neural networks. With the advent of the big data era, data collection and processing have become increasingly important. However, existing data acquisition systems often face challenges due to the diversity of data sources and the complexity of data formats. To address these issues, we propose a unified data measurement and acquisition system based on deep neural networks. Firstly, we design the overall architecture of the system. The system consists of three main components: data acquisition module, data processing module, and data storage module. The data acquisition module is responsible for collecting data from various sources, including sensors, databases, and network interfaces. The data processing module uses deep neural networks to preprocess and extract features from the collected data. Finally, the data storage module saves the processed data to a database for subsequent analysis and applications. Secondly, we provide a detailed description of the system implementation process. We use a convolutional neural network-based data processing module to handle image data, and a recurrent neural network-based data processing module to handle time series data. By training and optimizing these modules, we are able to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the system. Lastly, we evaluate the system through experiments. We use a set of real-world datasets to test the performance of the system. The experimental results show that our system has high accuracy and efficiency in data collection and processing. Furthermore, we compare our system with other related systems, and the results demonstrate significant advantages in terms of performance. In conclusion, this article proposes a unified data measurement and acquisition system based on deep neural networks, which effectively addresses some challenges in data collection and processing. Through experimental evaluation, we have demonstrated the feasibility and superiority of the system. In the future, we will further improve the system’s performance and apply it to a broader range of fields.

articleTitle: Analysis of Thermal Defects in Converter Transformer Windings Based on Electromagnetic-Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The simulation of temperature and flow distribution within the windings of oil-immersed converter transformers heavily depends on the widely used finite element numerical calculation method. However, the complex structure of converter transformers poses a challenge. Presently, 2D simulations primarily rely on empirical methods for determining oil flow distribution within windings. This approach has limited applicability and overlooks thermal defects arising from uneven winding welding. To address these issues, a 220 kV oil-immersed converter transformer is simulated using a 2D axisymmetric and 3D electromagnetic-fluid-thermal full-domain model, employing the finite element method. The simulation considers the inlet flow velocity of the converter transformer as the boundary condition, includes the oil circuit of the winding and the tank gap in the analysis, and assesses the temperature rise resulting from unevenness in the replacement welding of winding wires. Researchers anticipate that this study will contribute to the detection and elimination of issues during the design and installation phases of converter transformers.

articleTitle: Research on Lightweight Object Detection Algorithm Combining Channel Reconstruction Convolution and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Traditional YOLOv5s object detection network requires high computational resource and high deployment configuration. What’s more, it is difficult to achieve high accuracy and performance on embedded devices using traditional YOLOv5s. Therefore, to address these issues, another object detection model has been proposed, which is improved by utilizing the traditional YOLOv5s network model. Firstly, original network’s standard convolution module is replaced with a lightweight convolution module called spatial channel reconstructed convolution. Then, the SimAM attention mechanism is employed to improve the model’s capacity to extract picture characteristics and fuse data. Lastly, the original CIoU loss function is replaced with Inner-IoU, which increases the loss function’s regression accuracy. The Pascal VOC 2007 dataset is used to evaluate the suggested approach. According to the test findings, the enhanced algorithm outperforms the original method by $5.1 \%$ and $2.8 \%$, with recall rate and average accuracy of $96.8 \%$ and $89.9 \%$, respectively. In contrast to alternative object detection models, it demonstrates exceptional precision and efficacy. This indicates that the suggested approach offers notable benefits over traditional object detection methods.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Method for Curling Stone Based on Robust Subspace Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper explores a computer-assisted intelligent method for image feature extraction and trajectory tracking, focusing on robust subspace learning techniques. The proposed method is then applied to enhance the precision of trajectory tracking in high-standard curling stone games. Specifically, the proposed method investigates the method application to handle noisy and diverse image data across realworld scenarios. The paper meticulously examines the theoretical foundations and practical implementation, emphasizing their capacity to extract the real and significant curling stone movement trajectory features from the entire curling stone trajectory amid uncertainties. By employing robust subspace learning, the aim is to enhance the performance of curling stone trajectory analysis tasks, encompassing object recognition and scene understanding. The proposed techniques for intelligent trajectory feature extraction undergo a comprehensive evaluation, considering both effectiveness and versatility. The research outcomes significantly contribute to advancing computer vision systems, facilitating enhanced trajectory interpretation across diverse sports tracking applications, from surveillance to autonomous systems. Finally, simulation is conducted and provided to test the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Basketball Robot Target Detection System Based on Improved Robust Subspace Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Basketball robot competitions are an exceptional platform for autonomous robot research. Nonetheless, variations in lighting conditions notably impact the recognition of robot targets and distance measurement. This study introduces a computer-assisted approach for intelligent target feature extraction in basketball robot detection, centering on the Robust Subspace Learning (RSL) technique. The investigation focuses on its applicability in sports games, particularly addressing challenges arising from noisy and varied image data in real-world settings. The paper comprehensively examines both theoretical underpinnings and practical deployment, emphasizing the capability to extract genuine target features during robot locomotion. The utilization of RSL aims to enhance target detection accuracy, encompassing object recognition and scene interpretation. The proposed methods undergo thorough evaluation, considering both effectiveness and adaptability. Research findings significantly propel the advancement of computer vision systems, enhancing target detection capabilities across a spectrum of tracking applications, spanning from surveillance to autonomous systems. Finally, a computer-based simulation evaluates the feasibility of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Estimation of Remaining Useful Life for Lithium-Ion Batteries Based on Particle Filter-Corrected Empirical Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries are widely used in many fields. Conducting Remaining Useful Life (RUL) assessment can effectively identify the aging state and degradation trends, addressing safety issues arising from untimely battery replacement. This paper proposes a battery RUL estimation method based on a Particle Filter (PF) algorithm-corrected empirical model. Firstly, aging experiments are conducted to obtain degradation data under different rates and depths of discharge (DOD) aging conditions, and the most suitable model is selected from four commonly used empirical models. Secondly, combining known aging data, the PF algorithm is employed to correct the parameters of the empirical model, making it applicable to other aging conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that under different aging conditions and with varying known data, the absolute average relative errors in battery capacity estimation are within $1.5 \%$, and the absolute relative errors in RUL estimation are within 10%.

articleTitle: Node Load Rate Calculation Method based on Database Query Statistics in Load Balancing Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The calculation of node load rate has a crucial impact on the quality of load balancing strategies in distributed systems. The existing commonly used methods for calculating node load rates do not fully consider the current state of nodes, leading to a discrepancy between their calculation results and reality. This paper focuses on distributed information systems, taking databases as the starting point, and proposes a node load rate calculation method based on database query statistics to be used in load balancing strategies. It adopts a method of combining theoretical calculation data with benchmark performance testing data for analysis, fully considering the impact of factors such as data volume in distributed information system databases, peak database access periods, and data table indexes on calculation results. While ensuring the accuracy of node load rate calculation results, it minimizes the need for repetitive testing, conserves computer performance and energy resources, and reduces the time and economic expenses associated with node load rate calculation. The validation results of the algorithm indicate that the average error rate between the calculated database seconds per query (SPQ) and the actual values is as low as 1.7%.

articleTitle: Optimization of Single Tree Segmentation in Point Cloud Data by Machine Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This study aims to use machine learning methods to optimize single tree segmentation in point cloud data, in order to improve the automated extraction and analysis of vegetation information. This study designed and implemented an end-to-end model that combines Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Point Cloud Convolutional Network (PCNN) to adapt to the unique characteristics of point cloud data. Our model is significantly superior to the traditional methods in terms of IoU, Dice coefficient and accuracy. Through careful experimental comparison, the effectiveness and superiority of machine learning method in point cloud data processing are proved. The CNN+PCNN model successfully achieved high-precision segmentation of trees in point cloud data, and accurately captured the shape, structure and position information of trees. For different environments and tree species, the model shows certain robustness, which provides reliable support for vegetation analysis in complex scenes. This study has achieved remarkable results in the application of machine learning method to the task of single tree segmentation in point cloud data, which provides strong support for the intelligent processing of vegetation information.

articleTitle: Utilizing the BP Neural Network Model for Comprehensive Assessment of Physical Fitness among College Students
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To gain a deeper understanding of college students’ physical health, this study employed advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies. Through these methods, we carefully selected sensitive indicators closely related to the physical health of college students and adjusted health intervention measures accordingly. This research adhered to the “National Student Physical Health Standards” and conducted a comprehensive physical fitness assessment of all undergraduates at a certain university in 2023. During the data collection and analysis process, we focused on utilizing the error backpropagation algorithm to construct artificial neural network models of physical health for male and female college students. This algorithm, commonly used in machine learning, improves model accuracy and predictive capacity by adjusting network parameters to reduce prediction errors. The study results showed that the neural network models established for both male and female college students exhibited high accuracy and good fitting. For male students, the top three significant indicators of physical health were the 50-meter run, 1000-meter run, and lung capacity. For female students, these indicators were the 800-meter run, 50-meter run, and lung capacity. This finding is crucial for understanding the differences in physical health between genders. In summary, constructing ANN models for the physical health assessment of college students using artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies is not only feasible but also significant for optimizing evaluation indicators and health decision-making. This method provides a scientific basis for developing more effective health intervention measures, thereby promoting the overall health level of the college student population.

articleTitle: Video Compression and Action Recognition in Self-supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In computer vision, neural network models typically require a large amount of manually annotated images or video data for training. To reduce annotation costs, self-supervised learning has gained significant attention. This paper proposes a self-supervised learning-based method by introducing an auxiliary task involving spatiotemporal context in videos—extracting video keyframes—to guide self-supervised learning. The neural network learns video stream features by completing this task, thereby understanding the high-level semantics of the video. Additionally, this auxiliary task achieves video content redundancy reduction and video compression through keyframe extraction. To quantitatively evaluate the effectiveness of this method, the neural network is transferred to the domain of action recognition and experiments are conducted on the UCF101 dataset, achieving an accuracy of 66.2% with fewer parameters and training data. The validation of the effectiveness of this method as an auxiliary task for video spatiotemporal features contributes to a better understanding of video semantic features by neural networks and facilitates action recognition, thereby expanding the applications of self-supervised learning.

articleTitle: Predictive Models for Preventive Medicine based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Deep Learning (DL) algorithms have characteristics such as multi-level, multi perspective, and adaptive learning. With the improvement of computing power and the explosive growth of data volume, deep learning has achieved rapid development. With the development of modern biomedical and information technology, health management is gradually shifting from “passive” to “active”, and personalized health management and disease prevention are gradually becoming the focus of research in the field of public health. Traditional preventive medicine is mostly based on natural data, which makes it difficult to meet personalized prediction needs. It can obtain potential information through deep mining of data features, thereby improving the accuracy and clinical application value of disease risk prediction models. This article designs a predictive model for preventive medicine based on DL, and compares it with traditional preventive medicine through data analysis to evaluate the preventive learning predictive model designed in this article, and proposes relevant improvement measures. The research results indicate that the highest prediction accuracy of the preventive medicine prediction model based on DL can reach $\mathbf{9 6 . 2 \%}$.

articleTitle: Research on Ultrasound Image Based Prostate Cancer Auxiliary Diagnosis System
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Image processing technology has made remarkable breakthroughs in recent years, driven by both algorithms and computing power. Not only has the image quality achieved a qualitative leap, but also its application in the fields of medical image diagnosis, security monitoring and analysis has become more and more extensive, providing a strong support for the scientific and technological progress of the society and the convenience of daily life. Currently, Prostate cancer ranks as one of the most frequently occurring malignant tumours, and the study of prostate cancer ultrasound image-assisted diagnosis artificial intelligence system helps accurate diagnosis and timely treatment. The improved Mask R-CNN is used to accurately segment the prostate region from the background in ultrasound images of the prostate; then the background information is masked and multiple prostate ultrasound image datasets are constructed for use in the Inception-V3 network for image classification and detection. Compared with other detection methods, this method has higher accuracy. This study will effectively improve the efficiency of prostate cancer diagnosis work.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Lung CT Images Based on Multiscale Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of difficult segmentation and inaccurate segmentation of small lesions in lung Computed Tomography (CT) images, a multi-scale feature fusion deep learning prediction model that conforms to the observation of things by the human eye is proposed, and specific performance indicators and visualization results are given. The multi-scale feature fusion mechanism is used to effectively capture the long-distance characteristics of lesions. A joint loss function is proposed to make the training smoother and further improve the segmentation performance. The analysis is verified in the segmentation test set, and the results show that the overlap between the proposed model segmentation results and the real results has a Dice value of 83.29%, a sensitivity Sen of 82.66%, a cross-union ratio IoU of 73.15%, and a specificity Spec of 99.82%, which can better segment the lesion region compared with the existing algorithms. Therefore, using the proposed improved model to predict lung CT image lesions can be used clinically for doctors to diagnose diseases faster.

articleTitle: Research on Plant Pest and Disease Classification Based on Self-Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In everyday life, the classification of plant pests and diseases in images is deemed crucial. However, the collection and manual labeling of databases containing images of plant pests and diseases are considered time-consuming tasks. In this study aims to address this challenge by extracting image features from extensive, unlabeled datasets of plant pests and diseases. To achieve this, a self-supervised learning method utilizing the momentum contrast (MoCo) technique for image classification is introduced. Specifically, an approach named modify_arg_MoCo is proposed, which includes appropriate data augmentation techniques and learning rate settings based on a cosine schedule. Additionally, the impact of different momentum values, the presence of an MLP layer, and epoch parameters on classification outcomes was investigated. Experimental findings indicate that the modify_arg_MoCo method can achieve good classification accuracy (94.31%) in plant pest and disease images.

articleTitle: Research on Classification of Novel Coronavirus Pneumonia Based on Multi-scale Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In current research on COVID-19, researchers mostly use machine learning or deep learning models to classify extracted features. However, feature extraction directly affects the classification results of the models. Currently, COVID-19 diagnosis mainly faces issues of single-feature and highdimensional features. Therefore, a study proposes a COVID-19 classification method based on multi-scale wavelet transform. The study uses the public dataset COUGHVID, which contains COVID-19 cough signals, as the experimental data. Multi-scale wavelet transform is applied to extract features from the COVID-19 cough signals, and machine learning models such as Support Vector Machines, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors, and Logistic Regression are used for classification. After preprocessing and discrete wavelet decomposition, the spectral area and average power of the CD1 and CD3 wavelet coefficients are used as features and compared with MFCC features. Experimental results show that in the Random Forest model, the selected features achieve a classification accuracy of $\mathbf{9 6 . 9 \%}$, which outperforms the classification accuracy of MFCC features. Therefore, this method based on multi-scale wavelet transform can effectively classify COVID-19 patients. This research has significant implications for the application of machine learning models in COVID-19 diagnosis. By utilizing multi-scale wavelet transform and machine learning algorithms, we can extract key features from cough signals and use them for COVID-19 classification. The advantage of this method is that it captures disease-specific information from cough sounds, providing a non-invasive, low-cost, and accurate means for early diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: Study on Optimal Machine Learning Models for Recognizing Handwritten Digits: Considering Feature and Hyperparameter Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Handwritten numbers are common in important fields such as finance and education. Recognize them with high speed and accuracy can improve the work efficiency. The aim of this study is to assess the effectiveness of traditional feature selection techniques in enhancing the accuracy of classification algorithms in handwritten digit recognition and determine suitable classification algorithms and hyperparameters for this task. The experiment was conducted based on a large handwritten digit dataset, 3 common classification algorithms: K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Naïve Bayes (NB) and 2 feature selection methods: Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) and Chi-Square. The experiment first compared the accuracy of classification algorithms under original dataset and dataset based on feature selection, then compared the accuracy of classification algorithms under different parameters. Study found that traditional feature selection methods nearly can’t improve the accuracy of handwritten digit recognition, but can maintain classifiers’ accuracy at fewer features. This study also found suitable algorithms and hyperparameters for this task, which could provide some advice to this field. The conclusion is that traditional feature selection method is not recommended using in handwritten digit recognition considering the accuracy, $k=1$ to 9 for KNN and Gauss as kernel function for SVM are recommended using and NB is not suggested as it performs badly in this field.

articleTitle: Research on a Music Classification Algorithm with Multi-Feature Fusion Based on Genetic Algorithm-optimized Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The improvement of computer science and technology has largely spread its application to various fields. With the help of computer-assisted technologies, music enthusiasts can not only better discover their favourite music but also enhance the accuracy of music recommendation systems. This paper proposes a multi-feature fusion music classification method based on Genetic Algorithm-optimized Support Vector Machine (GA-SVM), further advancing the development of the music classification field. Firstly, for feature extraction, the inadequacy of a single audio feature representation by cleverly selecting four audio features is addressed: fundamental frequency, resonance peaks, Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients, and relative spectral-perceptual linear prediction are comprehensively considered. These features are skilfully integrated to construct a diverse feature matrix. Secondly, regarding classifier selection, considering the complexity of SVM parameter selection, the GA is employed to optimize SVM parameters, and successfully creating the GA-SVM music classification model. This model not only overcomes the problem of challenging parameter selection in traditional music classification methods but also, as demonstrated in experiments, significantly surpasses the classification accuracy of other comparative music classification methods.

articleTitle: Research on Insulator Defect Detection with Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As critical components in power transmission systems, insulators are constantly subjected to a variety of environmental conditions throughout the year, making them susceptible to malfunctions. Such failures can compromise the secure and reliable functioning of the transmission lines. Therefore, using deep learning to detect insulator defects in power inspection is a very important research direction, the current detection methods still face great challenges, such as complex backgrounds, etc., especially because the self-explosion defects of insulators are relatively small compared to the size target of insulators, and the detection performance is inadequate. To address this issue, this paper introduces a novel transformer-based insulator defect detection method, using the DERT target detection model, combined with the spatial pyramid structure, to enhance the accuracy of small-sized targets detection and realize the insulator defects detection. On the insulator defect database collected by ourselves in Meishan, Sichuan, the outcomes of the experiment demonstrate that the proposed method exhibits commendable efficacy in insulator defects detection, the detection AP of insulator defects reaches 94.3%, which has a good practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Image Feature Extraction Based on Robust Subspace Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper delves into intelligent image feature extraction, centering on robust subspace learning methods. It investigates their application to handle noisy and diverse image data across real-world scenarios. The paper meticulously examines the theoretical foundations and practical implementation, emphasizing their capacity to extract meaningful features from images amid uncertainties. By employing robust subspace learning, the aim is to enhance the performance of image analysis tasks, encompassing object recognition and scene understanding. The proposed techniques for intelligent image feature extraction undergo a comprehensive evaluation, considering both effectiveness and versatility. The research outcomes significantly contribute to advancing computer vision systems, facilitating enhanced image interpretation across diverse applications, from surveillance to autonomous systems. Finally, simulation is conducted and provided to test the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of Pseudorandom Sequence Generator Based on Cross-Coupled Chebyshev Lattice
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the widespread adoption of the internet, humanity has entered an irreversible era of information. Highquality pseudorandom numbers play a crucial role in ensuring secure communication, necessitating pseudorandom number generators with excellent performance. Therefore, research on pseudorandom number generators based on chaos theory is of vital importance. In this paper, a pseudorandom sequence generator based on the Cross-Coupled Chebyshev Lattice (CCML) model is proposed. CCML is a typical model in spatiotemporal chaos and exhibits better chaotic characteristics compared to low-dimensional chaotic systems. The generator first utilizes the classical Logistic map to generate the initial state values for each lattice cell. It then employs the Tent map to dynamically perturb the coupling coefficients between the lattice cells, enhancing the chaotic properties of the system. The local function in the model is a transformed Chebyshev map. The generator combines several one-dimensional chaotic mappings to demonstrate the excellent performance of a composite system. The pseudo-random sequences generated by the generator obtain high scores in the $0-1$ test, and the spectral entropy is significantly higher than that of other classical chaotic mappings, reaching a level close to that of white noise. It shows that the generator is capable of generating chaotic sequences with high complexity.

articleTitle: Research on Scene Generation Method of Visual Perception Test for Automatic Driving with Integrated Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to realize automatic driving simulation test, a large number of visual perception test scene are needed. Deep learning techniques can be used to create a huge number of virtual traffic scenarios for automated driving vision testing, which can increase test cycle speed, decrease experiment risk, and enhance system accuracy. However, generating high-resolution, diverse driving scene images from complex driving scene data sets remains a difficult goal to achieve. In this paper, based on stylegan2, we propose a method of visual perception test scene generation for automatic driving by integrating attention mechanism. Firstly, according to the actual requirements of the visual perception test of automatic driving, the driving scenes are classified to simplify the complexity of the generation of driving scenes. Secondly, in order to achieve automatic development of visual perception test scenarios for automatic driving, the stylegan 2 generator and discriminator are enhanced, and a self-attention module is included. The suggested technique can successfully lower background artifacts and increase the authenticity of visual perception test scene production, according to experimental results. Among them, the optimal FID value generated by the generation method on the unidirectional lane scene is 25.035, and the FID value is reduced by 7.328 compared with the unclassified stylegan 2 method.

articleTitle: Research on Efficient Image Feature Extraction based on Low-Rank Representation for Intelligent Reading Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Efficient and accurate extraction of image features is essential for ensuring high-performance information transmission in intelligent reading systems. This paper introduces a computer-assisted method for intelligent image feature extraction, specifically focusing on the Low-Rank Representation (LRR) approach. The study addresses challenges presented by noisy and diverse character or image data encountered in real-world scenarios. By employing LRR, the accuracy of image extraction, which includes object recognition and scene understanding, is significantly enhanced. Subsequently, the proposed techniques for intelligent image feature extraction undergo comprehensive evaluation, assessing both effectiveness and versatility through extensive experiment verifications. The experimental results validate the efficacy of the proposed method and demonstrate its superior image content extraction accuracy compared to existing methods. This proposed method provides crucial assistance to high-performance intelligent reading systems, thereby enhancing its applicability for potential consumers.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent English-Chinese Translation Proofreading System based on Gated Feedback Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Addressing the issue of the low precision inherent in conventional algorithmic approaches, this paper introduces an astute model for English translation identification, devised upon an enhanced Gated Feedback Recurrent Neural Network (GF-RNN) framework. This innovative model employs the refined algorithm to amass a substantial bilingual lexicon corpus, thus facilitating the automatic retrieval of phrases. In addition, this paper formulates and outlines the systematic execution of an astute English translation identification model by aggregating, refining, and deploying data. The recommended technique meticulously gathers and refines the input signals of English lexemes, isolating the characteristic parameters to empower the astute discernment in English translations. This paper conducts a rigorous experimental assessment of the fashioned English translation identification model and documents the empirical evidence. The ensuing scrutiny corroborates that the model not only attains superior precision but also adeptly meets the exigencies of translation endeavors in English.

articleTitle: A Fast Image Mosaic Algorithm Based on Feature Partition Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a fast image stitching algorithm based on feature partitioning extraction to address the issues of long processing time, high computational complexity, and poor stitching performance in existing image stitching algorithms. This algorithm is implemented through two stages: optimizing image registration and image fusion. In the image registration stage, feature extraction and accumulation are carried out using image partitioning and an improved Gaussian pyramid layer series method; In the image fusion stage, an improved adaptive weighted average fusion algorithm is used for image fusion operations to improve stitching efficiency and make the image clearer and more natural. Experimental verification shows that the algorithm has strong robustness, significantly improving feature extraction speed and matching rate. Compared with mainstream algorithms, the stitching speed has increased by nearly 2 times, and the image related evaluation indicators have increased by about $5 \%$, basically meeting the real-time and timely needs of image stitching in daily life.

articleTitle: Image Encryption Design Based on Henon Mapping
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Image data, compared to textual information, possesses visual characteristics that require novel encryption methods to ensure its security. Therefore, it is necessary to explore new encryption techniques tailored specifically for image data. By applying the Henon chaotic map, two random sequences are generated. These sequences, along with a given key, are used to produce four equally-sized random matrices through specific formulas. Two of these matrices are employed in the forward and backward diffusion modules, while the remaining two are utilized in the permutation module. Through two rounds of diffusion operations and one permutation operation, the four random matrices are utilized to encrypt the image, resulting in a secure, encrypted image.
