The security performance of this encryption algorithm is analyzed theoretically, considering encryption and decryption speeds, histogram statistical characteristics, correlations between adjacent pixels, and information entropy. Additionally, simulation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of this digital image encryption scheme, showcasing excellent encryption results and security performance.

articleTitle: An Edge Detection Algorithm of Noisy Image Based on OTSU Adaptive Threshold Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional edge detection algorithm is not effective in the edge detection of noisy image, this paper proposes an adaptive threshold OTSU based edge detection algorithm of noisy image. The algorithm takes into account the selection of filtering methods and thresholds, replacing the Gaussian filter used in the traditional Canny algorithm with an improved median filter. Secondly, the maximum inter-class variance OTSU is used to self-adapt the segmentation threshold. Firstly, the improved median filter algorithm removes part of the particle noise and preserves the edge to the maximum extent. Then the DoG operator is used to extract the edge information of the image, and finally the adaptive threshold value is calculated to the final binary edge detection image. Experimental results show that compared with traditional algorithms, the proposed algorithm has higher edge detection accuracy and better anti-noise performance.

articleTitle: The Enhanced UGV Cluster Navigation Methodology Based on MARL and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The main focus of this paper is to address the obstacle avoidance and path planning challenges in Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) cluster navigation tasks within unknown environments of a certain scale, proposing a Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) based method for UGV cluster navigation. The approach leverages the MATD3 algorithm, which features an architecture with two sets of Critic networks to mitigate the issue of overestimation in reinforcement learning. Additionally, an LSTM network is integrated to address the inefficiency in utilizing time-series information in sample data, guiding UGV clusters to achieve global mission objectives without relying on explicit environmental maps. Furthermore, to expedite neural network training for UGV clusters in unknown environments, the paper employs Pybullet to simulate unknown environments. Subsequently, this paper compares this algorithm with MADDPG and MATD3 methods, demonstrating that our proposed approach outperforms navigation tasks within unknown environments. UGV clusters utilizing LSTM-MATD3 achieve higher cumulative rewards and success rates, along with lower cluster collision rates. Experimental results affirm the feasibility and effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Video Logo Removal Processing Method Based on Matlab
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Batch removal or addition of video logos is a time-consuming and tedious task. It is necessary to develop an automated and rapid method for logo removal, particularly in the case of thousands of video waiting for processing. This paper introduces a video processing technique based on Matlab, capable of automatically identifying and erasing specific logos within video frames. This method not only maintains the original frame rate of the video but also preserves its audio content. The effectiveness and stability of the program have been verified through the processing of multiple video files. To maintain the overall consistency of the processed video, a Gaussian smoothing filter is also used to smooth the edges of the removed areas. This research provides an effective tool for the automated processing in the field of video editing. This tool saves time and effort and ensures that the process is efficient and consistent across all the videos.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Best-First Decision Table for Gesture Unit Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Gesture analysis has emerged as a prominent method in human-computer interaction innovation. Its evolution has extended its utility beyond traditional boundaries, notably in automating tasks associated with gesture phases segmentation for disclosure analysis. This study introduces an AI-driven Best- First Decision Table for gesture detection, compared against four distinct classification algorithms using the Weka data mining tool. A K-Star algorithm is also applied and compared to analyse the detection of gesture which is never been analysed in other papers. A data set of 20 attributes is used where the classes are divided into 5. The experimental results are analysed and compared against MultiLayer Perceptron (MLP) classification. The simulated results have shown that the proposed Best-First Decision Table and K-Stars have achieved a higher True Positive Rate than MLP with a higher F-Score without affecting the False Positive Rate.

articleTitle: Designing a Basketball Action Recognition System Based on the Improved OpenPose Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the realm of computer-assisted learning, video tutorials have gained significant traction for teaching various sports, including basketball. However, these tutorials often suffer from issues such as lack of standardization, clarity, and effectiveness. To address these challenges, this study presents a novel approach: a basketball action recognition system built upon an enhanced OpenPose algorithm. This system efficiently processes videos or images captured by learners, identifies crucial action frames, reconstructs human skeletal structures, computes joint angles, compares them with standard actions, and offers real-time posture correction guidance. Experimental validation showcases the system’s potential as a valuable tool for learning and honing basketball techniques. Furthermore, its adaptability suggests broader applications across diverse sports education contexts, emphasizing its practical significance and potential impact. The integration of machine learning algorithms ensures continuous improvement and customization, catering to individual learning needs and enhancing overall learning experiences.

articleTitle: Research on License Plate Location Algorithm in Complex Background
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of license plate location algorithm in complex background, based on the existing theory and method of license plate location, a research on the algorithm of license plate location in complex background is proposed, which is an edge detection and threshold segmentation algorithm based on improved cumulative absolute difference method. The improved cumulative absolute difference algorithm is used for differentiating the statistical information of the gray scale of the image; because the characters in the license plate contain rich edge information, the gray values of adjacent pixels of a single pixel point in a two-dimensional image are subjected to pairwise difference in the vertical direction, the image shall be binary segmented with combining the improved self-adaption threshold segmentation ideology with mathematical morphology after obtaining the difference image, and the unnecessary background shall be eliminated for obtaining the morphology result, the area of the license plate can be obtained with utilizing the law of the number of white pixel points in the vertical and horizontal direction according to the projection method of combining the vertical projection with the horizontal projection after the image being processed, finally, the part of the license plate can be located with the dummy area being removed. Through the improvement of the algorithm, the part of the license plate can be located accurately for 200 pictures under the conditions of uneven illumination, long distance, complex vehicle body, night condition and complex background, and the recognition rate is 92.5%.

articleTitle: Attention-based CNN-LSTM and XGBoost Hybrid Model for Air Quality Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Accurately predicting air quality is of significant importance for environmental management, economics, and public health. Over the past few decades, scientific algorithms for understanding and forecasting weather have continuously advanced, leading to the emergence of many excellent algorithms and applications. Due to the complex fluctuations in the environment, Conventional time series models like ARIMA have proven inadequate in capturing the nonlinear characteristics observed in air quality data. Neural networks possess powerful nonlinear generalization capabilities. In this paper, we propose the use of a hybrid model based on the attention mechanism of CNN-LSTM and XGBoost for predicting air quality based on five years of data from Wuhan City. We conduct experimental analysis and compare it with other models. Firstly, ARIMA is used for preprocessing, then a deep learning architecture is formed using a pre-training and fine-tuning framework. Finally, fine-tuning is performed on the XGBoost model. Compared with ARIMA (R2: 0.65758) and ARIMA-BiLSTM (R2: 0.61897), AttCLX achieves an R2 of 0.98887, indicating a significant improvement. By more accurately predicting air quality, we can better protect the environment, promote economic development, and safeguard public health. This has significant implications for government environmental policy-making, business planning of production activities, and individual health management.

articleTitle: Study on the Excitation Methods of Magnetostrictive Material Actuators
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This study investigates the output performance of Terfenol-D magnetostrictive materials under electromagnetic excitation, constructing a generic dynamic linear model for actuators based on the physical properties of magnetostriction. Utilizing this model to guide experiments on the actuator’s output displacement peak-to-peak values, it primarily examines the relationship between the input current frequency and the displacement output characteristics under conditions of varying bias magnetic fields, pre-stress magnitudes, and input voltage levels. Analysis of experimental data indicates that within the input current frequency range of 20Hz to 20kHz, the actuator’s output displacement is inversely proportional to the magnitude of the input current signal’s frequency, with a maximum displacement output of up to 40μm. These experiments not only validate the accuracy and practicality of the model but also lay a foundation and provide references for the subsequent design, optimization, and application of actuators.

articleTitle: A Method for Implicit Risk Detection and Evaluation of Chinese LLMs through TextCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have emerged prominently, rapidly being applied across various domains, especially with Chinese LLMs flourishing. However, these LLMs are prone to “illusion,” leading to the generation of implicit risks such as abusive, offensive, biases, and porn, which are difficult to detect. The scarcity of Chinese corpus exacerbates the challenge of detecting implicit risks in Chinese LLMs. This paper leverages LLMs to enhance training and testing data, to construct an implicit risk classification model framework, that integrates TextCNN with rule-based methods. Through experimental comparisons, our custom-built framework demonstrates superior performance relative to well-known domestic open-source content risk detection models. Furthermore, we conducted evaluation experiments on five representative Chinese LLMs. Building upon the method of inducing implicit risks through the prompts from integration of context and multi-round, our custom-built implicit risk classification model framework is better equipped to identify implicit risks generated by Chinese LLMs. Additionally, this paper establishes a set of implicit risk sample datasets, providing a reference for the study of implicit risks in LLMs.

articleTitle: YOLOv7-FDASR: Improved YOLOv7 for Fall Detection with Convolutional Attention Module and Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Object detection methods are important in human fall detection tasks. However, fall detection suffers from complex scene in reality, varying camera viewpoints, and low camera resolution, which poses a huge challenge to generalized object detectors. To solve these problems, we propose a super-resolution fall detector with an attention mechanism based on YOLOv7 (YOLOv7-FDASR). We introduce CBAM modules to enhance network expressiveness and refine network features. In the Head section, we introduce an independently designed lightweight super-resolution module for improving the image resolution and obtaining more feature information at high frequencies. Finally, WIoU is used as a loss function to effectively prevent low-quality object recognition from biasing the ideal recognition predictions in reality. Extensive experiments on real datasets, Fall-D and Falling, demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our proposed method in terms of detection performance. The achieved Average Precisions (APs) are $57.9 \%$ and $57.1 \%$ on the two datasets, respectively, representing an improvement of approximately ${5 \%}$ to $9 \%$ over the baseline (YOLOv7).

articleTitle: Research on Experimental Material Identification Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: At present, laboratory safety issues are frequent. To ensure experimental safety, a laboratory material identification algorithm is designed to achieve automation and intelligent management. By identifying materials on the desktop, recording, tracking, and managing the flow of materials, human errors are reduced, and safety is improved. This article will propose a deep learning based method for identifying experimental materials. Firstly, relevant material photos were collected for the three types of materials that need to be sorted in the experimental platform, and a dedicated dataset was formed through data augmentation. Then, by introducing the MobileNetV2 deep neural network model and analyzing its main structure and advantages. Finally, through actual data training and testing, it has been proven that this method can effectively achieve the sorting of experimental materials, with an accuracy rate of ${9 9 \%}$, and can meet the needs of material sorting on the experimental platform.

articleTitle: A Robust 3D Pose Estimation Algorithm Based on 2D Camera Arrays
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The implementation of 3D human posture estimation is one of the classic tasks in computer vision, which is the basis of posture recognition, behavior tracking, and human body tracking technologies, and has a wide range of potential applications in the fields of rehabilitation, video surveillance, and advanced human-computer interaction. Aiming at the problems of expensive traditional cameras used for 3D human posture estimation, complicated operation process, facing occlusion as well as depth uncertainty, an algorithm for multicamera soft synchronization based on a two-layer point matching strategy is proposed, and a probabilistic graph model based on the length of the skeleton is also established to optimize and fuse the results of 3D human posture estimation from multiple RGB cameras. First, a novel digital clock video is designed and a combination of global point matching based on deep learning and local point matching based on SIFT features is used as a strategy, where each camera array can obtain accurate image capture time simultaneously; on this basis, the least squares method is used to model the camera capture time (PC side) and shutter time (sensor side); 2D body pose after synchronization, 3D body pose obtained using triangulation. Finally, a probabilistic graph model based on bone length is established to decompose the graph dependency of the a posteriori probability to infer the global optimal solution of the human joint tree map, and the optimal 3D human pose is solved based on the process of non-parametric confidence propagation. Experiments show that the camera array algorithm of this novel soft synchronization algorithm can effectively synchronize almost all types of cameras, and the average absolute difference can reach below 11 ms. The probabilistic graphical model based on the bone length can provide accurate estimation of the 3D human body pose.

articleTitle: Research on Nonlinear Programming Problems Based on Random Forest Model and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the realm of daily life planning, the challenge of optimizing decisions is frequently encountered, with traditional methods often failing to achieve desired outcomes. To address this issue, this research proposes an innovative approach that combines random forest and genetic algorithms to obtain optimal solutions for nonlinear programming problems. The aim is to enhance the precision of solving nonlinear programming problems and improve the effectiveness of decision optimization in daily life planning. The research introduces important constraints on influencing factors in the design of the random forest model for nonlinear programming and utilizes genetic algorithms to solve the nonlinear programming problems, resulting in more accurate optimal solutions. The research findings demonstrate that this method not only optimizes the impact structure of various factors on the outcomes but also enhances the precision of the optimal solutions through genetic algorithms.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement and Deep Learning in Predicting the Gleason Score of Transcrectal Ultrasound Images of Prostate Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The Gleason grading system for prostate cancer offers a crucial point of reference for clinical evaluation of available treatment alternatives. However, there are few studies on pathological grading of prostate cancer ultrasound images, and how to accurately describe its aggressiveness is a hot issue. Therefore, this paper proposes a deep learning-based network model for Gleason grading of prostate cancer. The model consists of three modules: lesion region labelling, image enhancement, and pathological grading. Specifically, the model firstly uses the improved S-Mask R-CNN network model to label the prostate cancer lesion region, then performs image enhancement by morphological image processing and PCNN algorithm, and finally performs pathological grading of prostate ultrasound images using Xception. The experimental results on the prostate ultrasound image dataset collected in the hospital show that the prediction accuracy of the Gleason grading model in this paper is higher than that of other classical grading models and manual diagnosis by doctors.

articleTitle: Research on Diabetes Classification based on R-R Interval and Main Weight Amplitude Ratio Percussion Entropy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, data processing, disease prediction and diagnosis based on computational algorithms have become hot issues. At present, computer algorithms have been widely used in the classification and prediction of diabetes, and have shown great application value in clinical aspects, the aim of this study was to use a noninvasive approach to simultaneously extract the main weight amplitude ratio sequence of the pulse signal (PPG) and the RRI sequence of ECG, and the coincidence rate between them was calculated by percussion entropy algorithm for the classification of diabetes. In this experiment, the synchronous principal weight amplitude ratio sequences and RRI sequences of healthy subjects (Group 1: 30 people) and diabetic subjects (Group 2: 28 people) were extracted, and the anastomoses between them were calculated using PEn. The normal physiological parameters of the human body and PEn were tested using an independent-sample T-test and Pearson correlation analysis. Finally, the multi-scale cross-approximate entropy (MCAE) was compared with PEn. The results show that $\operatorname{PEn}(\mathbf{p}\lt 0.001)$ distinguished diabetic patients from healthy individuals in a way that was both considerably distinct and superior to MCAE ($\lt 0.05$), and PEn was negatively correlated with both glycosylated hemoglobin ($r=-0.451, p\lt 0.001$) and fasting blood glucose ($r=-0.359, p\lt 0.001$). Not only do the results of this study indicate that the percussion entropy of subject weight ratio sequence and RRI sequence is superior in predicting the vascular health status of diabetes, but they also indicate that the principal weight amplitude ratio sequence and RRI sequence can be used as characterization parameters for diabetes, demonstrating certain research significance for the early screening of diabetes.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis on Intelligent Recognition of Tea Disease Images Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The healthy and ecological development of the tea industry requires non-destructive testing and early identification of tea diseases, which is an indispensable part of the development of smart agriculture. Before the tea processing and production management process, timely identification and diagnosis of tea diseases are particularly crucial for the quality of tea. With the rapid development of deep learning technology in the field of image processing, image recognition technology of crop diseases by deep learning has gradually become the mainstream, which provides a new way for the rapid diagnosis of crop diseases. This article analyzes and discusses the current research status and progress in image processing, disease spot feature extraction, and recognition technology selection based on deep learning, providing reference for intelligent diagnosis of tea diseases. Finally, it summarizes the shortcomings of current upward learning methods, and prospects the development of intelligent recognition and diagnosis technology for tea image diseases in the future.

articleTitle: Advancements in Research on Analysis and Processing Methods for Few-shot Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper comprehensively and meticulously summarizes and organizes current research achievements from the perspectives of concepts in few-shot object detection and few-shot learning, methods for analysis and processing of fewshot images, and datasets and experiments. It provides a systematic summary and discusses the principles, merits, demerits, and suitability of various established approaches to analyze and process few-shot images. These methods may be divided into four groups: data augmentation, transfer learning, metric learning, and meta-learning. Readers can swiftly grasp this field’s current research focal points through graphical comparisons and analyses of different methods and their experimental results on various datasets. This paper reviews the latest methods, which serve as a valuable resource for researchers in this domain and further foster the advancement of few-shot image analysis and processing techniques.

articleTitle: Adolescent Physical Activity Intensity Recognition Method Based on LSTM Network and EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Neural networks and deep learning technologies have gained prominence in recent years due to their high flexibility across various fields. Ensuring adolescents engage in moderate exercise is crucial for overall health. However, a common concern arises from many adolescents participating in high-intensity exercise without due consideration, posing potential health risks and life-threatening situations. To address this, our paper proposes a method for recognizing adolescent physical activity intensity. This method leverages Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) artificial neural networks and Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals, enabling real-time monitoring to avert potential dangers associated with imprudent exercise. The research algorithm employs a multi-layered LSTM network to extract EEG signal features during exercise. Additionally, an integrated attention mechanism mimics biological visual attention behavior, distinguishing and prioritizing significant regions in the time series, suppressing irrelevant information, thereby enhancing monitoring efficiency and accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate a remarkable identification accuracy of 99.40%, affirming the diagnostic precision and generalization capabilities of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Self-distillation Networks for Zero-shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The purpose of zero-shot learning (ZSL) is to expand the samples that deep learning models can recognize. Typically, deep learning models can only recognize samples from seen classes that match the labels of the training set. To address the challenge of identifying samples from unseen classes that do not match the training set labels, ZSL has been proposed. ZSL is further divided into Conventional zero-shot learning (CZSL) and Generalized zero-shot learning (GZSL). However, existing ZSL models often exhibit poorer performance in GZSL compared to the corresponding standards in CZSL and traditional image classification. Additionally, there is typically a difference in parameters and weight between CZSL and GZSL, which can lead to serious overfitting: models trained with CZSL parameters often perform significantly worse in GZSL. In this work, drawing inspiration from distillation learning for transferring “dark knowledge” between different scenarios, we designed a self-distillation network. By controlling parameters and training sample distributions, we simulated the model’s superior recognition capabilities in CZSL and traditional image classification compared to GZSL and distilled them into the GZSL scenario. Before classification, samples pass through an AE module and correction network to ensure the extraction of parts consistent with semantic information. The reconstructed features of the AE module and relevant hidden representations of the correction network are then distilled. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed self-distillation network has successfully acquired knowledge under two more advantageous scenarios. Simultaneously, the establishment of an indirect relation through distillation learning alleviates the phenomenon of overfitting. The combination of both makes the proposed method outperforms models solely using GZSL parameters.

articleTitle: Investigation on Interlocking Faults of AC-DC System Induced by Device-level Defects under “Embedded” DC
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To resolve the issue of inadequate transmission capacity across the river section, Jiangsu Power Grid initiated an “embedded” DC project, leading to an intricate AC-DC hybrid connection configuration. The coupling of AC-DC has increased the risk of chain failure evolution. To improve the reliability of the AC/DC system under “embedded” DC, this study begins by investigating the chain fault evolution process in the AC/DC power grid. It explores how equipment defects lead to failures, impacting the normal operation of the DC system and potentially resulting in DC blocking. The abnormal operation of the DC system, in turn, induces voltage fluctuations in the AC/DC system and anomalies in power transmission. Building on this analysis and employing the Markov state-space method, we calculate the probabilities of equipment faults and protection refusals for the evolution of equipment defect faults and protection hidden faults. Subsequently, a state transfer model for the AC/DC system is constructed. Finally, using a simulation example, we analyze the operational risk associated with AC/DC system chain faults under embedded DC. The results show that implementing risk pre-control measures for the main equipment can effectively decrease the operational risk of AC/DC system chain faults under embedded DC.

articleTitle: CM-CAO-C2F Registration Method for Infrared/Visible Light Images Based on Knee Joint Contour
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The registration of infrared image with temperature change and visible image has clinical significance. Aiming at the problem that the current diagnosis of knee osteoarthritis is lack of wide applicability and the infrared/visible image with sparse features is difficult to register, a contour based infrared/visible image CM-CAO-C2F registration method of knee osteoarthritis is proposed. After the infrared image and visible image of the knee joint are enhanced, the contour of the legs in the two modal images is extracted; The curvature value of the image contour is calculated and the maximum curvature point is marked. The projection transformation matrix is obtained by coarse to fine registration based on the contour angle direction; The original infrared image is transformed according to the projection transformation matrix to obtain the final registration result. Experimental results show that CM-CAO-C2F achieves better image alignment than CAO-C2F, SIFT, SAR-SIFT, PSO-SIFT; When the image contains less information, the NMRSE values of CM-CAO-C2F are all close to 0, reducing to a certain extent. Compared with SAR-SIFT with smaller NRMSE values, the registration results of $\mathrm{CM}-\mathrm{CAO}-\mathrm{C} 2 \mathrm{~F}$ method are reduced by $35.52 \%$ on average. Compared with the other four methods, the SSIM value of CM-CAO-C2F method is larger. CM-CAO-C2F registration method solves the problem of sparse and difficult registration of infrared/visible image features of the knee joint, and can effectively help doctors to screen and diagnose KOA.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of Quality Control Throughout Production of Real Scene 3D Modeling Based on Oblique Aerial Photography
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As a new type of geographic data source, real 3D models can effectively complement the lack of facade and environmental information in traditional aerial remote sensing data captured from only downward perspective. Currently, there is a comprehensive push for real 3D construction in China. However, there are limited industry standards related to the quality inspection of 3D model outputs, which poses a challenge to ensuring the production quality of real 3D models. This study delves into the principles and workflow of oblique aerial photography for real 3D modeling, particularly focusing on techniques such as joint adjustment of multi-view imagery and dense matching of multi-view images. It identifies and analyzes the critical elements of quality control throughout the entire production process of oblique aerial photography 3D modeling. These elements and their specific impacts on the final product quality are examined one by one, leading to a summary of quality inspection methods for the entire production process. By conducting a qualitative inspection and evaluation of highprecision, large-scale oblique aerial photography real 3D modeling production examples in Shanghai, this study highlights five key advantages and disadvantages of this technology and offers recommendations. These insights provide valuable references for the development of industry standards for the quality inspection of oblique aerial photography real 3D model outputs. Furthermore, they offer a more sophisticated technical means for natural resource investigations, contributing to more precise and efficient natural resource management.

articleTitle: Research on Visual Recognition of Honeysuckle Based on an Improved YOLO v5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous evolution of machine vision technology, its application in agriculture, forestry, and other fields has become one of the focal points of research. This paper proposes an improved model based on machine learning specifically for the visual recognition of honeysuckle. Firstly, by constructing and optimizing the dataset, and utilizing Baidu PaddlePaddle BML for training set creation and fine-tuning, the model is enabled to better learn and understand the characteristics of honeysuckle. Secondly, advanced image preprocessing techniques, including bilateral filtering and the RGB color space model, are employed to enhance the segmentation precision and accuracy of honeysuckle. Subsequently, an innovative Coordinate Attention (CA) mechanism is introduced, allowing the model to focus more on pixel-level important information, thereby improving the recognition performance of honeysuckle. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves remarkable performance in the task of honeysuckle recognition, with an average precision of $\mathbf{7 8 . 6 \%}$, representing a $\mathbf{1 0 . 1 \%}$ improvement compared to the unmodified algorithm. This ensures high-speed recognition based on YOLO v5 while effectively enhancing the algorithm’s robustness.

articleTitle: Research on SARIMA-LSTM Crime Prediction Model Based on Nonlinear Combination of RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Addressing the limitations of existing crime prediction models in capturing the composite features of crime time series data and responding promptly to environmental changes, this paper designs a crime prediction model based on the non-linear combination of Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural network, SARIMA, and LSTM. In this model, the prediction results of crime quantities from SARIMA and LSTM undergo non-linear combination through an RBF neural network, utilizing backpropagation algorithm for weight learning. The weight matrices determined by each layer’s neurons function as the proportions of the two methods in the combined prediction. By synergizing the advantages of the SARIMA model in linear time series prediction and the LSTM network in non-linear feature exploration, the model aims to enhance predictive accuracy. Experimental comparisons with real crime data from Vancouver and San Francisco affirm that the SARIMA-LSTM model, grounded in the non-linear combination of RBF neural network, excels in capturing the composite features of crime time series data, exhibiting superior accuracy compared to other models.

articleTitle: Chinese Text Classification Based on Improved BERT Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In response to the lack of Chinese text classification models, the existing Chinese character embedding method is optimized and improved. The new method is effectively integrated with the BERT model, and the HeberText model for Chinese text classification is proposed. First of all, propose the alternative method of pronunciation and glyph characteristics of Chinese characters under the constraint of small character set, which effectively integrate and transform the phonetic and shape features of Chinese characters, and further implement two Chinese character embedding enhancement models named FastZi and YaoBiGRU. Then, the two are deeply fused with the BERT model, and the fine particlebased enhanced characters based on the Chinese character sound shape are embedded to achieve the HeberText model for Chinese text classification; Finally, verification experiments were performed on multiple classification datasets. The results show that the improved model not only effectively solves the problem of out of vocabulary words in Chinese text, but also has significantly improved the category accuracy.

articleTitle: Contrastive Enhanced Filter Model Based on Bidirectional Transformer for Sequential Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Transformer-based sequential recommendation is highly powerful as it can capture short-term and long-term sequential recommendation. It plays a crucial role in personalized recommendation systems, aiming to extract dynamic and diverse preference information from users’ realtime growing behaviors. This is mainly due to its unique selfattention mechanism, which utilizes item-item interactions within the sequences. However, in online platforms, due to the interweaving of items in user behavior, user behavior data inevitably contains noise. Currently, most methods model user preferences in the time domain, overlooking the influence of frequency patterns on user behavior. To address this issue, this paper shifts the perspective to the frequency domain and proposes a novel contrast-enhanced filtering model for sequential recommendation based on the bidirectional Transformer, called CEFRec. Specifically, the paper designs a filtering layer on top of the bidirectional Transformer, allowing learnable filters to operate on different layers’ spectra. This enables the model to capture various frequency patterns and adaptively attenuate noise information within the frequency domain. Next, the model combines the cloze task mask and dropout masks to generate high-quality positive samples and utilizes contrastive learning to enhance the quality of user embeddings learned from the frequency domain. Finally, experimental results on three public benchmark datasets demonstrate that the CEFRec model outperforms state-of-theart sequential recommendation models.

articleTitle: Comparison of Biocode Based Machine Learning and Segmentation Model for Automated Prawn Size Prediction for Real Prawn Farm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The aquaculture industry has witnessed a significant surge in technological integration over the past decade, leveraging advancements in the Internet of Things (IoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance production efficiency. Monitoring the growth of aquatic cultures, such as fishes and prawns, plays a pivotal role in optimizing production. However, traditional methods, notably in prawn aquaculture in Asia, still heavily rely on stress-inducing techniques like netting and manual measurements. This paper proposes a novel approach using YOLO-based detection algorithm with biocode reference point based on the ArUco design to predict prawn size based on the length and are dimension to analysed the improvement in predicting the size. The propose solution is compared extensively using statistical tests against segmentation model with and without fine-tuning. Initial results show that both YOLOv8 segmentation and YOLOv8 with Segment Anything Model (SAM) give similar results with the actual mean length of 15.7 cm and predicted mean lengths are 20.5 cm and 20.8 cm respectively. However, after fine-tuning the parameter, the accuracy of predicted results improved significantly with 15.8 cm for YOLOv8 segmentation and 16 cm for YOLOv8 with SAM. The mean absolute error of 0.93 cm for YOLOv8 segmentation and 1.10 cm for YOLOv8 with SAM, and the width of 0.48 cm and 0.78 cm respectively.

articleTitle: A Multi-Task Learning Framework for TextureAware Chromatic Aberration Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, although methods based on traditional image processing technology have dominated the field of automated surface chromatic aberration detection of ceramic tiles, they only focus on texture patterns or color features. Faced with the increasing complexity of ceramic tile textures and colors, these traditional methods have shown significant limitations, and there are complexity issues such as the detection of chromatic aberration in tiles of the same model but with different textures. Moreover, effectively applying deep learning techniques to ceramic tile chromatic aberration detection remains a challenge. In order to solve the numerous issues encountered by traditional and deep learning methods in detecting chromatic aberration in complex textured tiles, This paper presents a multi-task learning framework for chromatic aberration detection, which includes two stages: multi-task image representation and chromatic aberration detection. In the first stage, a deep learning-based multitask model was designed to extract texture information and global color features, and its effectiveness has been proven through experiments on widely used texture datasets and real ceramic tile datasets. In the chromatic aberration detection stage, the histogram of the ceramic tile image in the CIEL* $a^{*} b^{*}$ color space and the mean and variance of the corresponding template ceramic tile image (flag features) are extracted and fused with the features extracted in the first stage, forming a descriptor that represents the ceramic tile image. This image descriptor will be used in the training of the Multilayer Prceptron (MLP) to obtain a classifier for chromatic aberration detection. Experiments on real ceramic tile datasets have shown that this chromatic aberration detection framework can efficiently and accurately detect defective products with chromatic aberration.

articleTitle: Inner Mongolia Egg Price Prediction Based on PCA-BOA-SVR Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Inner Mongolia is one of the important egg production areas within China. To encourage the egg business in Inner Mongolia to grow in a healthy and sustainable manner, a total of 244 sets of monthly average egg prices in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region from January 2003 to April 2023 were used as experimental data. PCA dimensionality reduction was performed on the characteristic data that affects egg prices. Butterfly Optimization Algorithm (BOA) was used to optimize Regression using Support Vector Machines (SVR) and a PCA-BOA-SVR model was constructed. A study was conducted on the prediction of egg prices in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region from April 2022 to April 2023. The findings indicate that the PCA-BOA-SVR model’s root mean square error is 0.1033, and the R2 is 0.9585, which are better than the SVR model optimized using genetic algorithm (GA) and the single SVR model. This suggests that egg prices can be predicted more precisely using the PCA-BOA-SVR model.

articleTitle: Geometric Attacks Resistant Zero-watermarking for Color Images Using Local Multi-channel Fractional-order Exponential Moments and SPM Chaos Mapping
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Zero-watermarking is a technique that does not alter the original content for copyright protection and is a popular research area in the domain of digital watermarking. To overcome the limitations of existing zero-watermarking schemes in terms of robustness and security, this paper presents a novel color image multiple zero-watermarking scheme that uses local feature regions (LFRs) and Multichannel fractional-order exponential moments (MFrEMs). The proposed scheme first applies the Scale-invariant feature transform (SIFT) detector to obtain the stable key points of color carrier images and then uses feature scales to build stable LFRs, then MFrEMs of LFRs are computed separately to construct multiple feature sequences using magnitude. SPM chaos mapping is applied to scramble the binary watermarked images to increase the security of the scheme. The feature sequences of each LFR and the encrypted watermarked images are subjected to an exclusive OR (XOR) operation to generate multiple zero-watermarking. Various experiments are performed to assess the proposed multiple zero-watermarking scheme, the results obtained show that the proposed scheme not only has better security but also shows greater robustness against both image processing and desynchronization attacks.

articleTitle: Detecting Malicious Behaviors in PDF Document: A Hybrid Features Detection Method on System Calls
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The PDFs are usually treated as static documents in traditional impression, while the added functions in the new specifications make PDFs almost as powerful as executables. Although researchers have proposed many solutions, there are still some shortcomings, such as excessive overhead and being susceptible to parser confusion. In this paper, we propose a new perspective of PDF detection. Our insight is that malicious PDF documents often hide their malicious behaviors among benign ones but can be captured by the underlying traces of the operating system (OS) such as system calls. Based on this intuition, we propose a novel selection algorithm to identify suspicious parts in a system call sequence, complemented by a signal analysis method to extract global features. We evaluate our approach on a dataset of 848 documents, achieving a good detection performance with the ROC value of 0.98. Furthermore, we conduct a comprehensive interpretability study to understand the internals of the mode. Experimental results show that, compared with other methods, the proposed model has outstanding performance in feature extraction and training, effectively improving the accuracy of PDF detection.

articleTitle: Few-Shot Encrypted Traffic Classification: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Encrypted traffic classification is an essential technique for maintaining cybersecurity and assuring quality of experience. Current research has achieved excellent classification performance by utilizing machine learning or deep learning methods. However, the constantly emerging new encryption services make collecting labeled traffic samples increasingly difficult, failing to meet the training requirements of pre-existing models. Therefore, encrypted traffic classification with few-shot learning has emerged as an increasingly popular research area. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive survey and summary of the latest advancements in few-shot encrypted traffic classification, categorizing existing methods into: data augmentation-based, transfer learningbased, metric learning-based, meta-learning-based, and pretraining-based approaches. We introduce the principles and typical works of these methods and discuss their advantages and limitations. Finally, we summarize the research findings and provided insight into potential avenues for future inquiry.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Task Mapping Scheme Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of technologies such as artificial intelligence and big data, diverse application scenarios have increasingly high demands for model training. The single-machine training mode can no longer meet the requirements of large-scale training, and the use of distributed training in heterogeneous clusters composed of multiple computers or servers has gradually become the mainstream solution. Task mapping is a key component of the heterogeneous cluster task execution process, which has a significant impact on the performance of the cluster and the running efficiency of tasks. However, current task mapping schemes are difficult to adapt to the high heterogeneity of cluster resources and the diversity of large-scale tasks. Therefore, how to effectively establish the mapping relationship between different types of tasks and heterogeneous computing resources has become an urgent problem to be solved. In view of this question, the main work and innovative achievements of this thesis are as follows: To address the task mapping problem in large-scale heterogeneous clusters for distributed training, a machine learning-based dynamic task mapping scheme is proposed. The core modules of this scheme are the phase detector and ANN performance predictor. Specifically, the IPC is introduced as a processing core performance indicator in the phase detector, which is used to detect phase changes during task execution, accurately selecting the remapping timing. By selecting appropriate static and dynamic features in the ANN performance predictor, we can effectively predict the behavioral differences of different types of tasks on heterogeneous resources, and design mapping schemes that maximize system performance based on these predictions. Finally, simulation experiments were conducted to compare the proposed scheme with the Completely Fair Scheduler(CFS) and Round Robin Scheduler(RRS). The results show that the completion time of distributed training tasks under the proposed scheme is reduced by 25% and 44%, respectively, and the resource utilization rate is increased by 7% and 13%, respectively.

articleTitle: Social Network Security Data Analysis and Identification Model: Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network Improvement Research
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The security of the social network (SN) has become an increasingly important concern, and long sequence data are unable to be processed by the traditional neural network (NN) model when collecting Weibo security topic information. Therefore, this work uses the enhanced Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) in deep learning (DL) to analyze the SN’s security. The specific method is extracting Weibo topic information utilizing a memory intelligence algorithm’s Long Short-Term Memory architecture. The big data and CNNs mine and search the Weibo and SN security topics. The experimental findings indicate that, following 120 iterations, the enhanced DCNN model’s recognition accuracy achieves a crest value of $96.17 \%$, surpassing the other three models by a minimum of $5.4 \%$. Furthermore, the intrusion detection system has F1, recall, and accuracy values of $88.57 \%$, $\mathbf{7 2. 0 5} \%$, and $\mathbf{7 5. 2 2} \%$. In the least favorable scenario, the developed model outperforms other methodologies by $3.1 \%$ in recall, accuracy, and F1 value. The testing and training time for the enhanced DCNN model remains stable at 27.90 and $\mathbf{6 5. 8 6}$ seconds, demonstrating notable efficiency compared to analogous literature methods. The experimental finding suggests that the enhanced DCNN within the framework of DL exhibits characteristics of reduced latency, showcasing commendable efficacy in secure network data transmission. This work aims to offer a valuable reference for researching and applying SN security-related fields through big data and NN technology.

articleTitle: An Ultra High Definition Array Camera System and Parallel Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of technology, array camera systems, serving as a collaborative system of multiple cameras, exhibit broad prospects in areas such as surveillance, image processing, and computer vision. However, the development of array cameras is constrained by the challenges of large-scale data processing. This paper aims to address key technical issues related to the efficiency of digital image processing while delving into the design and implementation of array camera systems. To meet the demands of digital image processing in a multi-core environment, a parallel image data processing architecture is proposed, effectively mitigating issues arising from the lengthy execution times associated with serial data processing and enhancing the speed and efficiency of digital image processing. The design and integration of the array camera system are realized at both the hardware and algorithmic levels. Through the optimization of optical design and mechanical support structures, the hardware integration and debugging of the array camera system are achieved. At the algorithmic level, a parallel algorithm for digital image processing in a multi-core environment is employed, facilitating functions such as multi-channel video capture, pre-processing, transmission, and post-processing. This comprehensive approach provides a holistic solution for advanced security monitoring technology.

articleTitle: Research on Basketball Player Tracking Method Based on Multi-Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Multi-object tracking is a hot topic in the field of computer vision, which is widely used in intelligent transportation, intelligent surveillance, autonomous driving, and other fields. With the rapid development of the sports industry, the problem of athlete tracking in sports has gradually attracted attention. Unlike pedestrian tracking in ordinary surveillance scenarios, athlete tracking in sports scenarios faces great challenges due to frequent occlusion, large pose changes, and the similar appearance of athletes. This article takes basketball player tracking as the research object, focusing on the methods of athlete detection and tracking. To address the problem of low accuracy due to the similarity of athletes’ appearance, this paper proposes a basketball player tracking algorithm based on multi-feature fusion. First, a multi-branch re-identification model for athletes is designed. The global branch learns the global semantic information of the athletes; the local branch horizontally partitions the body parts of the athletes to learn fine-grained features; the feature deletion branch deletes the most activated part of the features, forcing the network to learn the remaining significant features. Then, the features of the three branches are merged to improve the discriminability of the athletes. Finally, experiments are conducted on the dataset, and the results show that the proposed method achieves good performance.

articleTitle: Investigation into Airborne Target Intent Recognition Technology Utilizing Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The determination of aerial target intent is a pivotal element for effectual aerial countermeasure training. Conventional rule-based strategies depend on an extensive assortment of domain-specific knowledge, whereas recognized target recognition techniques including template matching, knowledge mapping, Bayesian networks, neural networks, decision trees, and Hidden Markov Chains display notable limitations such as protracted training periods, intricate parameter optimization, and inconsistent recognition accuracy. To mitigate these limitations, this paper introduces a novel approach to aerial target intent recognition by deploying a extreme learning machine. The distinctive advantage of this method is its ability to leverage the rapid training speed and robust generalization capability of the superior learning machine, thereby enhancing the speed and precision of airborne target identification. Empirical findings from simulation experiments, complemented by subsequent comparative analysis with alternative methods, suggest that the proposed approach offers a balanced trade-off between training velocity and recognition accuracy. Therefore, it represents a promising progression in the realm of airborne target intent recognition.

articleTitle: Human Pose Estimation Network Based On MultiHeatmap Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Estimating human pose in complex multi-frame situations is a challenging task and has attracted intensive research by many researchers. Although 3D human pose estimation methods have achieved remarkable results in scenes based on single images, their performance often fails once these model transformations are applied to video sequences. Common problems with these models include inability to cope with motion blur, out-of-focus videos, and occlusion of human poses. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a feature extraction and representation model MHMF, which is used in the feature extraction stage of the model. The initial features extracted by the backbone network HRNet-w32 are guided by the heat map to the attention layer, which improves the network’s attention to important areas for predicting key points of human posture. At the same time, the integration of the aggregation heat map and the backbone network heat map improves the spatiotemporal consistency of the key points. In addition, to improve the accuracy of mesh pose estimation under occlusion, this paper proposes a transformer-based NewDSTformer model. By adjusting the structure of the Transformer encoder, increasing the encoder level and combining it with the dynamic progressive attention masking method. The model can adapt to different input situations, handle the positional relationship of local key points, and be able to perform accurate detection even under occlusion. It was evaluated on the 3DPW data set and improved the accuracy by $0.3 \%$, indicating that this paper effectively improved the performance of 3D human mesh reconstruction.

articleTitle: Investigating the Effectiveness of Different Feature Selection and Reduction Methods in Improving Classification of Low Dimensional Medical Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Clinical medical datasets usually exhibit high dimensionality that can lead to curse of dimensionality, making the differences between data negligible in machine learning. Feature selection or reduction methods can help to improve machine learning algorithms by identifying key features. However, in low-dimensional datasets with limited features, these preprocessing techniques can reduce prediction accuracy. Hence, this paper investigates the effectiveness of feature selection methods on three different machine learning algorithms namely Artificial Neural Network, Support Vector Machine, and Random Forest algorithms. As comparison, Sequential Forward Selection (SFS), Sequential Backward Selection (SBS), and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) have been selected to identify optimal feature subsets from low-dimensional medical datasets. Results from simulation have shown all methods can successfully identify important features within each dataset. However, no significance improvements have been observed in term of accuracy, precision, and processing time when optimal subsets in the classification algorithms. Principal Component Analysis has been applied as a feature reduction method, resulting in comparable outcomes across the datasets. Our study shows that there is the limited effectiveness of feature selection and reduction techniques on low-dimensional datasets.

articleTitle: Design of Management Information System Architecture Based on Big Data and Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A distributed equity management information system architecture for big data and blockchain technology is proposed. By designing the double-chain structure of villager shareholders’ Individual Shareholder Blockchain (ISB) and Economic Association Blockchain (EAB), and designing attributebased encryption, the rural equity data is subjected to fine-grained access control and secure sharing. In the context of big data and blockchain technology, the lowest cost of simulating the dual chain structure rural economic equity trading system is 23697.63, the shortest time is 1716.111 hours, the highest success rate is 99.85%, which is 101.50% higher than 98.37 % of the traditional trading system, and greatly improves the transaction success rate and query efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis and Parameter Identification of Bidirectional LLC Resonant Converter Based on Data Driven
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: At present, few people have studied the fault diagnosis of bidirectional LLC resonant converters. In order to promote the development of digital and intelligent fault diagnosis of power converters, this article analyzes the structural and parametric fault characteristics of bidirectional LLC resonant converters, designs structural fault diagnosis algorithms based on Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Random Forest (RF), and compares the diagnostic results of the two algorithms. Among them, the accuracy of random forest fault diagnosis is $100 \%$, the accuracy of SVM fault diagnosis is $98.58 \%$, the accuracy of RF fault diagnosis is higher, and the fault diagnosis speed is faster; At the same time, a bidirectional LLC resonant converter resonant capacitor parameter identification algorithm based on Extreme Learning Machines (ELM) and Deep Neural Network (DNN) was studied. As a deep learning algorithm, DNN has an identification error of less than $5 \%$ and significantly better performance than ELM. The data-driven bidirectional LLC resonant converter fault diagnosis and parameter identification carried out in this article have achieved good results, laying a foundation for subsequent engineering applications.

articleTitle: Personalized Financial Product Recommendation Algorithm Based on Look-alike
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, it has solved various problems. Due to the lack of personalized promotion methods for financial products, marketing targeting is not strong, and efficiency and effectiveness are generally poor. The paper proposes targeted personalized marketing strategies based on different consumer psychology, behavior, and demand characteristics, to achieve strong and effective marketing communication with different consumer groups in the target market with high input-output ratio. In order to meet the specific and common needs of different customer groups, this paper analyzes the user tag data of financial industry customers, constructs a user feature system, and proposes a feature combination look-alike algorithm to predict the accurate customer group of personalized products. At the same time, it also reduces the customer maintenance costs of the bank, improves marketing efficiency and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection Algorithm Based on Multi-scale Bidirectional Distillation
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Detecting anomalies in industrial settings is a critical task aimed at timely identifying and recognizing abnormal conditions in industrial production to enhance product quality, avoid production interruptions, and reduce losses. This paper proposes a novel bidirectional distillation paradigm for anomaly detection tasks. The teacher-student (T-S) architecture consists of a teacher network and a student network, where the student network includes both a forward encoder and a reverse decoder branch. The reverse branch uses low-scale high-dimensional features generated by the teacher network to reconstruct the feature distribution of the teacher network at various scales and make predictions. Additionally, the method proposes a multi-scale feature fusion embedding model, which fuses and reduces the dimensionality of the teacher network’s features at various scales to generate more accurate images. The method has been extensively experimented and tested on the MVTec AD dataset, outperforming other state-of-the-art approaches in both anomaly detection and localization, validating its performance in anomaly detection tasks.

articleTitle: Diabetes Identification Network Based on PPG’s Deep Supervision Combined with Residual Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of the field of computer and artificial intelligence, it also has a positive impact on the daily nursing monitoring of diabetes, and further facilitate the interactive communication between patients and healthcare professionals. Fingertip pulse signal acts as a common human physiological signal contain a significant amount of potential cardiovascular-related information that can be used to complete diabetic people predictive assessments, and reveal the potential association and evaluation value of with diabetes. The paper proposes a SE_ResNet method with deep supervision to achieve the classification of the diabetic population. We added a normalization layer within the residual attention module to reduce the effects of interlayer regularization and overfitting, meanwhile, the last three modules are integrated as supervised modules to complete the multiscale learning of deep abstract information providing additional regularization during network training. Multiscale learning through the integrated supervision can improve the utilization of deep abstraction information and further improve the prediction performance. The experimental results show that the fragment recognition accuracy of the proposed algorithm can reach 87.58%, of which the recognition rate of G1 and G2 can reach more than 90%, and the recall rate of G2 is 93.23%, the size of the three types of F1-scores is more than 85%. Compared with other commonly used classification algorithms, it has a good improvement effect. The proposed network model has good feature extraction and utilization ability, and has good robustness and high classification prediction results.

articleTitle: Insulator State Evaluation of GIS Based on Partial Discharge Optical Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Partial discharge is the main cause of insulation degradation in Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and is an important characterization of insulation deterioration. This paper designs a typical discharge defect optical and electrical joint measurement system for GIS bowl-type insulators. The system consists of a power frequency voltage application system, a bowl-type insulator test model, a partial discharge electrical measurement system, and a partial discharge optical measurement system. It can perform partial discharge detection for bowl-type insulators. Based on the experimental system, this paper explores the discharge development process of solid insulation materials used in GIS, studies the evolution of macroscopic sensing quantities such as electricity and light from the beginning of discharge to breakdown, proposes an assessment method for the severity of discharge using solid insulation materials in GIS, diagnoses the extent of damage to insulation caused by defects under the action of the electric field, and then carries out effective fault early warning to improve the maintenance level of GIS equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Unmarked Motion Action Recognition Technology Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The main purpose of this study is to explore the issues of real-time, accurate, and unmarked recognition of sports movements in recent years. By reviewing the relevant research on machine learning or deep learning for specific sports or target actions based on computer vision image data input, the aim is to provide references for the application of unmarked motion capture technology in the field of sports motion recognition. The research employed a literature review methodology, conducting searches in six databases, namely Web of Science, PubMed, Scopus, Google Scholar, IEEE Xplore, and China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), covering publications from January 2000 to June 2020. Through boolean logic operations on the retrieved literature, key information such as first author/publication year, types/targets of motion, participant information, camera parameters, image feature extraction techniques, action recognition algorithms, evaluation methods for action recognition quality, training and validation methods for image data, and performance metrics for action recognition were extracted. After screening, a total of 23 articles were included in the study. The findings revealed that $39 \%$ of the studies utilized machine learning algorithms based on support vector machines, while $35 \%$ employed deep learning algorithms based on convolutional neural networks. Commonly used evaluation metrics for action recognition quality included classification accuracy, confusion matrix, and displacement error. The development of computer vision motion capture, models, and algorithms demonstrated promising applications in areas such as action technique recognition and sports performance analysis. Traditional machine learning algorithms like support vector machines and principal component analysis remain dominant in action recognition technology; however, in certain scenarios, the performance of deep learning algorithms surpassed that of traditional machine learning methods. The development of computer vision-based field camera setups, image feature extraction, and action recognition algorithm model requires a multidimensional assessment considering specific sports, application scenarios, and accuracy requirements. With the advancement of deep learning recognition algorithms and wearable wireless sensing technology, the precision, real-time capability, and robustness of unmarked motion capture are expected to further improve.

articleTitle: Cross-domain Image Translation Algorithm based on Self-cross Auto-encoder
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The purpose of unsupervised cross-domain image translation is to learn the joint distribution of image domains by using the edge distribution of each image domain. However, there are infinite joint distributions that all conform to the given marginal distribution, so it is impossible to infer a reasonable joint distribution from the marginal distribution without any additional assumptions. The current method has problems such as conversion failure and conversion region error. To solve the above problems, a cross-domain image conversion algorithm based on self-cross auto-encoder is proposed. Instead of modeling the two image domains separately with two auto-encoders, the two image domains that convert each other are considered as a whole, and a self-cross auto-encoder is designed to model the overall data distribution, so as to achieve high-quality translation of cross-domain images, which can reduce the size of the network, reduce the number of parameters and increase the operation efficiency. To prove the effectiveness of the algorithm, validation tests have been done on several datasets. Compared with the existing SOTA cross domain methods, the algorithm reduces the number of parameters and the space occupied by parameters by $15 \%$, and the conversion speed is increased by 2 to 3 times, resulting in a better cross-domain image translation effect.

articleTitle: Research on 2D Visual Recognition Model of Badminton Action Based on Improved YOWO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The research on action recognition of badminton players is limited to single-frame image analysis, which ignores the continuity of behavior and fails to make full use of video information to efficiently and accurately judge whether the players violate the rules. In order to solve this problem, an improved YOWO (You Only Watch Once) algorithm is proposed, which is designed to make full use of video information to identify the movements of badminton players. In this paper, the AVA format video data set of athletes’ behavior is collected, and the Temporal Shift Module (TSM) is introduced to enhance the ability of the model to obtain time context information, and the Non-local operation module is used to improve the ability of the model to extract key location information. These improvements together improve the recognition accuracy and robustness of the algorithm in complex environments. The experimental results show that the optimization of the YOWO model has achieved significant improvement in key indicators such as mAP value, model parameter number and calculation amount. Compared with the traditional target detection algorithm and support vector machine (SVM) classification method, the algorithm shows obvious advantages in accuracy and mobility.

articleTitle: Unidirectional Encrypted Traffic Classification: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Techniques for classifying encrypted traffic typically rely on learning the interaction patterns between communicating parties to determine the traffic category. However, with the widespread application of asymmetric routing mechanisms and link load balancing, a large volume of network equipment cannot observe the complete bidirectional traffic, posing challenges to the deployment of existing methods. In order to solve this problem, research into unidirectional encrypted traffic classification methods has gradually emerged. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey of existing unidirectional encrypted traffic classification methods and showcase the latest research progress in this field. Based on how to resolve the contradiction between unidirectional traffic data and model reliance on bidirectional interaction features, we categorize existing methods into three main types: 1) unidirectional feature separation-based methods, 2) unidirectional feature mining-based methods, and 3) pairwise feature prediction-based methods. This paper details the characteristics of each method and discusses their advantages and disadvantages. We hope our work will draw researchers’ attention to the real-world network environment, thereby better promoting the development of the encrypted traffic classification field.

articleTitle: FFGAN: Feature Fusion GAN for Few-shot Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development and wide application of deep learning in large-scale data training models, the problem of insufficient data has become a constraint on the performance and applicability of deep learning models. In response to this issue, researchers have proposed methods based on feature fusion. However, existing feature fusion methods have certain limitations in terms of generating diverse and accurate images. To further improve the effectiveness of image classification tasks, this paper proposes a novel method for few-shot image generation based on local feature fusion. This method combines the concepts of Feature Fusion and Generative Adversarial Networks (FFGAN) to improve the quality and diversity of generated images. It addresses issues such as spatial misalignment in generated images. Additionally, this paper introduces a local reconstruction loss to optimize the local feature fusion module. The local reconstruction loss improves the quality of few-shot image generation by enforcing the generated images to closely resemble the corresponding local positions of input images in certain local regions. Finally, extensive experiments are conducted in image generation, image classification and image visualization.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Endogenous Security Cyber Range based on Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As an essential and important infrastructure for the research, testing and verification of cyberspace security technologies and offensive and defensive drills, cyber range has been increasingly valued by governments and cyber security enterprises. This paper studies the key technologies of the current cyber range and digital twin technology, proposes an endogenous security network range model based on the digital twin model, designs a virtual and real combination network scene generation algorithm based on the multi-commodity flow model, and constructs an endogenous security network target range with endogenous security properties. It allows for the validation of resource control strategies and the analysis of attack traffic, thereby enhancing the reliability, availability, and security of network systems. Based on the constructed endogenous security network range, six “Qiangwang” mimic defense international elite Challenge competitions were held. The successful holding of the challenge fully verified the correctness of the cyber range model based on digital twin technology and virtualization technology. This endogenous security network range can represent the future development trend of cyberspace target range.

articleTitle: RoomGen: 3D Interior Furniture Layout Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Lowering the costs of generating realistic indoor scenes upon customer’s requests, automatic synthesis of diverse indoor furniture layouts opens the door to various innovative business models for the real estate and home improvement industry. With the continuous development of deep generative networks, the quality of their generation results is constantly improving and occupies an important position in industrial design. Therefore, how to utilize deep generative networks to design indoor 3D scene layout with high quality and high level is of great significance to improve the design efficiency.
